local function geniter(f, s, c)
	if type(f) ~= "function" then
		local mt = getmetatable(f)

		if type(mt) == "table" and mt.__iter then
			f, s, c = mt.__iter(f)
		elseif type(f) == "table" then
			f, s, c = next, f, nil
		end
	end

	return function()
		local r = table.pack(f(s, c))

		if r[1] == nil then
			return false
		end

		c = r[1]

		return true, table.unpack(r, 1, r.n)
	end
end

local function GetGradientSeq(theme)
    local startC = theme.GradientStart or theme.Accent
    local endC = theme.GradientEnd or theme.Accent
    return ColorSequence.new{
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, startC), 
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, endC)
    }
end

for _, t in pairs(Themes) do
    if not t.Gradient then
        t.Gradient = GetGradientSeq(t)
    end
    if not t.ElementAccent then
        t.ElementAccent = t.Accent
    end
    if not t.Font then
        t.Font = "Gotham"
    end
end

local function GetAssetId(id)
    if not id or id == "" then
        return ""
    end
    local str = tostring(id)
    if str:find("rbxasset://") or str:find("rbxthumb://") or str:find("rbxassetid://") then
        return str
    end
    local num = str:match("%d+")
    if num then
        return "rbxassetid://" .. num
    end
    return ""
end

local function SetImageAsync(instance, property, idStr)
    local parsedId = GetAssetId(idStr)
    if parsedId == "" then
        instance[property] = ""
        return
    end
    
    instance[property] = parsedId
    
    if parsedId:find("rbxassetid://") then
        task.spawn(function()
            local success, result = pcall(function()
                return game:GetObjects(parsedId)[1]
            end)
            if success and result and result:IsA("Decal") then
                if instance.Parent then
                    instance[property] = result.Texture
                end
            end
        end)
    end
end

local function GetTheme(cfg)
    if type(cfg) == "table" then 
        local mapped = {}
        mapped.Main = cfg["Main color"] or cfg.Main
        mapped.Second = cfg["SecondColor"] or cfg.Second
        mapped.Accent = cfg["AccentColor"] or cfg.Accent
        mapped.ElementAccent = cfg["ElementColor"] or cfg.ElementAccent
        mapped.Text = cfg["TextColor"] or cfg.Text
        mapped.GradientStart = cfg["GradientStart"] or mapped.Accent
        mapped.GradientEnd = cfg["GradientEnd"] or mapped.Accent
        
        if cfg["BGTransparency"] then
            mapped.Transparency = tonumber(cfg["BGTransparency"]) / 100 
        else
            mapped.Transparency = cfg.Transparency
        end
        
        if cfg["ImageTransparency"] then
            mapped.ImageTransparency = tonumber(cfg["ImageTransparency"]) / 100
        else
            mapped.ImageTransparency = cfg.ImageTransparency
        end
        
        if cfg["OrbsTransparency"] then
            mapped.OrbsTransparency = tonumber(cfg["OrbsTransparency"]) / 100
        else
            mapped.OrbsTransparency = cfg.OrbsTransparency
        end

        if cfg["BackgroundID"] then
            mapped.Background = GetAssetId(cfg["BackgroundID"])
        else 
            mapped.Background = GetAssetId(cfg.Background) 
        end

        if cfg["Font"] then
            mapped.Font = cfg["Font"]
        end

        if cfg["CornerRadius"] ~= nil then
            mapped.CornerRadius = cfg["CornerRadius"]
        end

        if not mapped.Main then mapped.Main = Themes.Default.Main end
        if not mapped.Second then mapped.Second = Themes.Default.Second end
        if not mapped.Accent then mapped.Accent = Themes.Default.Accent end
        if not mapped.ElementAccent then mapped.ElementAccent = mapped.Accent end
        if not mapped.Text then mapped.Text = Themes.Default.Text end
        if not mapped.TextDark then mapped.TextDark = Color3.fromRGB(170, 170, 170) end
        if not mapped.Error then mapped.Error = Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60) end
        if not mapped.GradientStart then mapped.GradientStart = mapped.Accent end
        if not mapped.GradientEnd then mapped.GradientEnd = mapped.Accent end
        
        mapped.Gradient = GetGradientSeq(mapped)
        return mapped
    end

    if isfile(Library.ThemeFolder .. "/" .. tostring(cfg) .. ".json") then
        local content = readfile(Library.ThemeFolder .. "/" .. tostring(cfg) .. ".json")
        local parsed = HS:JSONDecode(content)
        local restored = {}
        for k, v in pairs(parsed) do
            if type(v) == "table" and v.R then
                restored[k] = Color3.new(v.R, v.G, v.B)
            else
                restored[k] = v
            end
        end
        if restored.GradientStart and restored.GradientEnd then
            restored.Gradient = ColorSequence.new{
                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, restored.GradientStart),
                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, restored.GradientEnd)
            }
        else
            restored.GradientStart = restored.Accent
            restored.GradientEnd = restored.Accent
            restored.Gradient = ColorSequence.new{
                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, restored.Accent),
                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, restored.Accent)
            }
        end
        if not restored.ElementAccent then restored.ElementAccent = restored.Accent end
        if not restored.Font then restored.Font = "Gotham" end
        if not restored.TextDark then restored.TextDark = Color3.fromRGB(170, 170, 170) end
        if not restored.Error then restored.Error = Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60) end
        if restored.CornerRadius == nil then restored.CornerRadius = 10 end
        return restored
    end
    return Themes[cfg] or Themes.Default
end

local function Create(class, properties)
    local tag = properties.ThemeTag
    properties.ThemeTag = nil
    local instance = Instance.new(class)
    for k, v in pairs(properties) do
        instance[k] = v
    end
    if class == "TextLabel" or class == "TextButton" or class == "TextBox" then
        table.insert(Library.TextObjects, instance)
        if not properties.Font then
            instance.Font = Library.GlobalFont
        end
    end
    if tag and Library.ThemeObjects[tag] then
        table.insert(Library.ThemeObjects[tag], instance)
    end
    return instance
end

local function UpdateFonts(FontName)
    local NewFont = Enum.Font[FontName] or Enum.Font.Gotham
    Library.GlobalFont = NewFont
    local BoldName = FontName .. "Bold"
    if pcall(function() return Enum.Font[BoldName] end) then
        Library.GlobalFontBold = Enum.Font[BoldName]
    else
        Library.GlobalFontBold = NewFont
    end

    for _, obj in pairs(Library.TextObjects) do
        if obj and obj.Parent then
            local s = tostring(obj.Font)
            if s:find("Bold") then
                obj.Font = Library.GlobalFontBold
            else
                obj.Font = Library.GlobalFont
            end
        end
    end
end

local function UpdateThemeObjects()
    for i = #Library.ThemeObjects.Main, 1, -1 do
        local obj = Library.ThemeObjects.Main[i]
        if obj and obj.Parent then
            obj.BackgroundColor3 = Themes.Default.Main
        else
            table.remove(Library.ThemeObjects.Main, i)
        end
    end
    for i = #Library.ThemeObjects.Second, 1, -1 do
        local obj = Library.ThemeObjects.Second[i]
        if obj and obj.Parent then
            obj.BackgroundColor3 = Themes.Default.Second
        else
            table.remove(Library.ThemeObjects.Second, i)
        end
    end
    for i = #Library.ThemeObjects.Accent, 1, -1 do
        local obj = Library.ThemeObjects.Accent[i]
        if obj and obj.Parent then
            if obj:IsA("ImageLabel") or obj:IsA("ImageButton") then
                obj.ImageColor3 = Themes.Default.Accent
            elseif obj:IsA("UIStroke") then
                obj.Color = Themes.Default.Accent
            else
                obj.BackgroundColor3 = Themes.Default.Accent
            end
        else
            table.remove(Library.ThemeObjects.Accent, i)
        end
    end
    for i = #Library.ThemeObjects.ElementAccent, 1, -1 do
        local obj = Library.ThemeObjects.ElementAccent[i]
        if obj and obj.Parent then
            if obj:IsA("ImageLabel") then
                obj.ImageColor3 = Themes.Default.ElementAccent
            elseif obj:IsA("UIStroke") then
                obj.Color = Themes.Default.ElementAccent
            else
                obj.BackgroundColor3 = Themes.Default.ElementAccent
            end
        else
            table.remove(Library.ThemeObjects.ElementAccent, i)
        end
    end
    for i = #Library.ThemeObjects.Text, 1, -1 do
        local obj = Library.ThemeObjects.Text[i]
        if obj and obj.Parent then 
            if obj:IsA("TextLabel") or obj:IsA("TextBox") or obj:IsA("TextButton") then
                obj.TextColor3 = Themes.Default.Text 
            elseif obj:IsA("Frame") then
                obj.BackgroundColor3 = Themes.Default.Text
            end
        else
            table.remove(Library.ThemeObjects.Text, i)
        end
    end
    for i = #Library.ThemeObjects.TextDark, 1, -1 do
        local obj = Library.ThemeObjects.TextDark[i]
        if obj and obj.Parent then 
            if obj:IsA("ImageLabel") then
                obj.ImageColor3 = Themes.Default.TextDark
            elseif obj:IsA("Frame") then
                obj.BackgroundColor3 = Themes.Default.TextDark
            elseif obj:IsA("UIStroke") then
                obj.Color = Themes.Default.TextDark
            else
                obj.TextColor3 = Themes.Default.TextDark
            end
        else
            table.remove(Library.ThemeObjects.TextDark, i)
        end
    end
    for i = #Library.ThemeObjects.ShellOutline, 1, -1 do
        local stroke = Library.ThemeObjects.ShellOutline[i]
        if stroke and stroke.Parent then
            if Library.MenuStyleShellActive and Library.Style then
                stroke.Color = Library.Style.Outline
            else
                stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(110, 110, 110)
            end
        else
            table.remove(Library.ThemeObjects.ShellOutline, i)
        end
    end
    for i = #Library.ThemeObjects.Toggles, 1, -1 do
        local t = Library.ThemeObjects.Toggles[i]
        if t.Box and t.Box.Parent and t.Stroke and t.Stroke.Parent and t.Square and t.Square.Parent then
            if t.State() then
                t.Stroke.Color = Themes.Default.ElementAccent
                t.Stroke.Transparency = 0
                t.Square.BackgroundColor3 = Themes.Default.ElementAccent
            else
                t.Stroke.Color = Themes.Default.TextDark
                t.Stroke.Transparency = 0.8
                t.Square.BackgroundColor3 = Themes.Default.TextDark
            end
        else
            table.remove(Library.ThemeObjects.Toggles, i)
        end
    end
    for i = #Library.ThemeObjects.TabLabels, 1, -1 do
        local tab = Library.ThemeObjects.TabLabels[i]
        if tab.Label and tab.Label.Parent then
            if tab.Btn.BackgroundTransparency < 0.8 then 
                tab.Label.TextColor3 = Themes.Default.Text 
                if tab.Icon then
                    tab.Icon.ImageColor3 = Themes.Default.ElementAccent
                end
            else 
                tab.Label.TextColor3 = Themes.Default.TextDark 
                if tab.Icon then
                    tab.Icon.ImageColor3 = Themes.Default.ElementAccent
                end
            end
        else
            table.remove(Library.ThemeObjects.TabLabels, i)
        end
    end
    for i = #Library.ThemeObjects.Keybinds, 1, -1 do
        local btn = Library.ThemeObjects.Keybinds[i]
        if btn and btn.Parent then
            if btn.Text == "..." then
                btn.TextColor3 = Themes.Default.Accent
            else
                btn.TextColor3 = Themes.Default.TextDark
            end
        else
            table.remove(Library.ThemeObjects.Keybinds, i)
        end
    end
end

local function UpdateGradients(newGradient)
    for _, grad in pairs(Library.GradientObjects) do
        if grad and grad.Parent then
            grad.Color = newGradient
        end
    end
end

local function UpdateCorners(val)
    Library.GlobalCornerValue = val
    for i = #Library.CornerObjects, 1, -1 do
        local obj = Library.CornerObjects[i]
        if obj.Corner and obj.Corner.Parent then
            obj.Corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, math.floor(obj.BaseRadius * (val / 10)))
        else
            table.remove(Library.CornerObjects, i)
        end
    end
end

local function AddCorner(instance, radius)
    local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, math.floor(radius * (Library.GlobalCornerValue / 10)))
    corner.Parent = instance
    table.insert(Library.CornerObjects, {Corner = corner, BaseRadius = radius})
    return corner
end

local function CreateDropShadow(parent, blurRadius, opacity)
    local Shadow = Create("ImageLabel", {
        Parent = parent,
        AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
        Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
        Size = UDim2.new(1, blurRadius * 2, 1, blurRadius * 2),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Image = "rbxassetid://5554836806", 
        ImageColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0),
        ImageTransparency = opacity or 0.5,
        ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Slice,
        SliceCenter = Rect.new(120, 120, 136, 136),
        ZIndex = (parent.ZIndex or 1) - 1
    })
    return Shadow
end

local function AddStroke(instance, theme)
    -- Astra tarzi: duz gri cizgi; Menu Style aktifken pastel mauve outline kullanir.
    local stroke = Create("UIStroke", {
        Color = (Library.MenuStyleShellActive and Library.Style and Library.Style.Outline) or Color3.fromRGB(110, 110, 110),
        Thickness = 1,
        Transparency = 0.5,
        ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border,
        Parent = instance
    })
    table.insert(Library.ThemeObjects.ShellOutline, stroke)
    return stroke
end

local function AddSoftOrbs(parent, theme)
    local Container = Create("Frame", {
        Parent = parent,
        Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        ZIndex = 2,
        ClipsDescendants = true
    })
    AddCorner(Container, 12)
    
    local function Spawn(size, color)
        local Orb = Create("Frame", {
            Parent = Container,
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size, size),
            Position = UDim2.fromScale(math.random(5, 95) / 100, math.random(5, 95) / 100),
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
            BackgroundColor3 = color,
            BackgroundTransparency = theme.OrbsTransparency or 0.9,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            ZIndex = 2
        })
        AddCorner(Orb, 1000)
        
        Create("UIGradient", {
            Parent = Orb,
            Transparency = NumberSequence.new{
                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.3),
                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1)
            }
        })
        
        task.spawn(function()
            while Orb.Parent do
                if parent.AbsoluteSize.X == 0 or not parent.Visible then
                    task.wait(1)
                    continue
                end

                local targetPos = UDim2.fromScale(math.random(10, 90) / 100, math.random(10, 90) / 100)
                local tween = TS:Create(Orb, TweenInfo.new(math.random(15, 30), Enum.EasingStyle.Sine), {Position = targetPos})
                tween:Play()
                tween.Completed:Wait()
            end
        end)
    end
    
    for i = 1, 8 do
        local orbSize = math.random(150, 400)
        local orbColor = (i % 2 == 0) and theme.Accent or theme.Second
        Spawn(orbSize, orbColor)
    end
    
    return Container
end

local function CreateRipple(btn, color)
    btn.ClipsDescendants = true
    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        local ripple = Create("ImageLabel", {
            Name = "Ripple",
            Parent = btn,
            Image = "rbxassetid://4743389506",
            ImageColor3 = (Library.ActiveTheme and Library.ActiveTheme.ElementAccent) or color,
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            ImageTransparency = 0.5,
            Position = UDim2.new(0, Mouse.X - btn.AbsolutePosition.X, 0, Mouse.Y - btn.AbsolutePosition.Y),
            Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0),
            ZIndex = 20,
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
        })
        local tween = TS:Create(ripple, TweenInfo.new(0.6, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Size = UDim2.new(0, 500, 0, 500), ImageTransparency = 1})
        tween:Play()
        tween.Completed:Connect(function()
            ripple:Destroy()
        end)
    end)
end

local function MakeDraggable(topbar, frame)
    local dragging, dragInput, dragStart, startPos
    topbar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging = true
            dragStart = input.Position
            startPos = frame.Position
            input.Changed:Connect(function()
                if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                    dragging = false
                end
            end)
        end
    end)
    topbar.InputChanged:Connect(function(input) 
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragInput = input
        end 
    end)
    local inputChangedConnection = UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if input == dragInput and dragging then
            local delta = input.Position - dragStart
            TS:Create(frame, TweenInfo.new(0.08, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)}):Play()
        end
    end)
    if Library.WindowConnections then
        table.insert(Library.WindowConnections, inputChangedConnection)
    end
end

local function MakeResizable(handle, frame, onResize)
    local dragging, dragStart, startSize

    handle.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging = true
            dragStart = input.Position
            startSize = frame.AbsoluteSize
        end
    end)

    local inputChangedConnection = UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if not dragging or (input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
            return
        end

        local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
        local viewport = camera and camera.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1280, 720)
        local isMobile = UIS.TouchEnabled and (viewport.X < 850 or viewport.Y < 600)
        local minX = isMobile and 280 or 500
        local minY = isMobile and 300 or 350
        local delta = input.Position - dragStart
        -- Like RESO, there is no maximum size; only a minimum is enforced.
        local newX = math.max(minX, startSize.X + delta.X)
        local newY = math.max(minY, startSize.Y + delta.Y)

        -- WindowContainer is top-left anchored, so changing Size leaves that corner fixed.
        frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(newX, newY)
        if onResize then
            pcall(onResize, newX, newY)
        end
    end)

    local inputEndedConnection = UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging = false
        end
    end)
    if Library.WindowConnections then
        table.insert(Library.WindowConnections, inputChangedConnection)
        table.insert(Library.WindowConnections, inputEndedConnection)
    end
end

local function AttachHorizontalScroll(box, scrollingFrame, defaultAlignment)
    defaultAlignment = defaultAlignment or Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    
    box:GetPropertyChangedSignal("TextBounds"):Connect(function()
        if scrollingFrame.AbsoluteWindowSize.X > 0 and box.TextBounds.X > scrollingFrame.AbsoluteWindowSize.X then
            box.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        else
            box.TextXAlignment = defaultAlignment
        end
    end)

    box:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CursorPosition"):Connect(function()
        if box:IsFocused() and box.CursorPosition > 0 then
            
            local textToCursor = string.sub(box.Text, 1, box.CursorPosition - 1)
            local size = TxtS:GetTextSize(textToCursor, box.TextSize, box.Font, Vector2.new(10000, 100))
            
            local visibleStart = scrollingFrame.CanvasPosition.X
            local visibleEnd = visibleStart + scrollingFrame.AbsoluteWindowSize.X
            
            local padding = 12
            if box.TextXAlignment == Enum.TextXAlignment.Left then
                if size.X > visibleEnd - padding then
                    TS:Create(scrollingFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.1), {CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(size.X - scrollingFrame.AbsoluteWindowSize.X + padding * 2, 0)}):Play()
                elseif size.X < visibleStart + padding then
                    TS:Create(scrollingFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.1), {CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(math.max(0, size.X - padding * 2), 0)}):Play()
                end
            end
        end
    end)
end

local function GetLucide(name)
    if type(name) ~= "string" then return nil end
    local d = LucideIcons[string.lower(name)]
    if not d then return nil end
    return {
        Image = "rbxassetid://" .. d[1],
        Offset = Vector2.new(d[2], d[3]),
        Size = Vector2.new(48, 48)
    }
end

local function ApplyIcon(img, icon)
    local l = GetLucide(icon)
    if l then
        img.Image = l.Image
        img.ImageRectOffset = l.Offset
        img.ImageRectSize = l.Size
        return true
    end
    img.ImageRectOffset = Vector2.new(0, 0)
    img.ImageRectSize = Vector2.new(0, 0)
    SetImageAsync(img, "Image", icon)
    return false
end

function Library:KeySystem(Settings)
    local Config = Settings or {}
    local Key = Config.Key
    if not Key or Key == "" then
        return
    end
    
    local LinkToCopy = tostring(Config.Link or "https://google.com")
    local SelectedTheme = GetTheme(Config.Theme)
    local Validated = false

    local ScreenGui = Create("ScreenGui", {
        Name = "KeyUI",
        ResetOnSpawn = false,
        DisplayOrder = 20000
    })
    
    if RS:IsStudio() then
        ScreenGui.Parent = LP:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
    else
        pcall(function()
            ScreenGui.Parent = CG
        end)
        if not ScreenGui.Parent then
            ScreenGui.Parent = LP:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
        end
    end

    local VP = workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize
    local IsMobile = UIS.TouchEnabled and (VP.X < 850 or VP.Y < 600)
    local KeySizeX = IsMobile and math.min(VP.X - 40, 450) or 450

        Parent = ScreenGui,

    AddStroke(Main, SelectedTheme)

    AttachHorizontalScroll(Input, InputBG, Enum.TextXAlignment.Left)

    Input.Focused:Connect(function()
        TS:Create(InputStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.3), {Transparency = 0}):Play()
    end)
    Input.FocusLost:Connect(function()
        TS:Create(InputStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.3), {Transparency = 0.8}):Play()
    end)

    local CheckColor = Color3.new(SelectedTheme.Accent.R * 0.8, SelectedTheme.Accent.G * 0.8, SelectedTheme.Accent.B * 0.8)
    
    local CheckBtn = Create("TextButton", {
        Parent = Content,

    })
    AddCorner(CheckBtn, 8)
    CreateRipple(CheckBtn, Color3.new(1, 1, 1))

        Parent = Content,
        Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -40, 0, 42),
        Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 10, 0, 145),
        BackgroundColor3 = SelectedTheme.Second,
        BackgroundTransparency = 0.4,

    })

    CreateRipple(GetKeyBtn, SelectedTheme.Accent)
    AddStroke(GetKeyBtn, SelectedTheme).Transparency = 0.7

        Parent = Content,
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20),
        Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -35),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Text = "Protected System",
        Font = Library.GlobalFont,
        TextColor3 = SelectedTheme.TextDark,
        TextSize = 13,
        ZIndex = 3
    })

    local function BtnHover(btn, isAccent)
        local hoverTween, leaveTween
        btn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
            if leaveTween then leaveTween:Cancel() end
            hoverTween = TS:Create(btn, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {BackgroundTransparency = isAccent and 0 or 0.2})
            hoverTween:Play()
        end)
        btn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
            if hoverTween then hoverTween:Cancel() end
            leaveTween = TS:Create(btn, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {BackgroundTransparency = isAccent and 0.1 or 0.4})
            leaveTween:Play()
        end)
    end
    BtnHover(CheckBtn, true)
    BtnHover(GetKeyBtn, false)

    GetKeyBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() 
        local success, err = pcall(function()
            if setclipboard then
                setclipboard(LinkToCopy)
                return true
            elseif toclipboard then
                toclipboard(LinkToCopy)
                return true
            elseif syn and syn.write_clipboard then
                syn.write_clipboard(LinkToCopy)
                return true
            elseif Clipboard and Clipboard.set then
                Clipboard.set(LinkToCopy)
                return true
            end
            return false
        end)
        if success then
            Status.Text = "Link copied to clipboard!"
            Status.TextColor3 = SelectedTheme.Accent
        else
            Status.Text = "Check Console (F9)"
            Status.TextColor3 = SelectedTheme.Error
        end
        task.wait(2)
        Status.Text = "Protected System"
        Status.TextColor3 = SelectedTheme.TextDark
    end)

    CheckBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        if Input.Text == Key then 
            TS:Create(KeyContainer, TweenInfo.new(0.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)}):Play()
            TS:Create(Shadow1, TweenInfo.new(0.4), {ImageTransparency = 1}):Play()
            TS:Create(Shadow2, TweenInfo.new(0.4), {ImageTransparency = 1}):Play()
            task.wait(0.4)
            ScreenGui:Destroy()
            Validated = true
        else
            Status.Text = "Incorrect or Invalid Key!"
            Status.TextColor3 = SelectedTheme.Error
            InputStroke.Color = SelectedTheme.Error
            InputStroke.Transparency = 0
            
            local x = KeyContainer.Position.X.Scale
            local y = KeyContainer.Position.Y.Scale
            for i = 1, 5 do
                KeyContainer.Position = UDim2.fromScale(x + math.random(-1, 1) / 150, y)
                task.wait(0.04)
            end
            
            KeyContainer.Position = UDim2.fromScale(x, y)
            task.wait(1)
            
            InputStroke.Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
            InputStroke.Transparency = 0.8
            Status.Text = "Protected System"
            Status.TextColor3 = SelectedTheme.TextDark
        end
    end)
    
    repeat
        task.wait()
    until Validated
end

    function B.DecodeAsset(encoded, fileName)
        if type(encoded) ~= "string" or encoded == "" then return "" end
        local getAsset = getcustomasset or getsynasset
        if type(writefile) ~= "function" or type(getAsset) ~= "function" then return "" end
        local ok, result = pcall(function()
            local map, chars = {}, "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
            for index = 1, 64 do map[chars:byte(index)] = index - 1 end
            local bytes, bits, value = {}, 0, 0
            for index = 1, #encoded do
                local digit = map[encoded:byte(index)]
                if digit then
                    value, bits = value * 64 + digit, bits + 6
                    if bits >= 8 then
                        bits = bits - 8
                        bytes[#bytes + 1] = string.char(math.floor(value / (2 ^ bits)) % 256)
                        value = value % (2 ^ bits)
                    end
                end
            end
            writefile(fileName, table.concat(bytes))
            return getAsset(fileName)
        end)
        if ok and type(result) == "string" and result ~= "" then return result end
        return ""
    end
    function B.Resolve()
        if B.Attempted then return B.Asset end
        B.Attempted = true
        B.Asset = B.DecodeAsset(B.PNG, "ANONIM_SpiderMan_Background_v1.png")
        return B.Asset
    end
    function B.ResolveHero()
        if B.HeroAttempted then return B.HeroAsset end
        B.HeroAttempted = true
        B.HeroAsset = B.DecodeAsset(B.HeroPNG, "ANONIM_SpiderMan_Hero_v1.png")
        return B.HeroAsset
    end
    function B.SetEnabled(main, image, enabled)
        local state = B.State
        if not enabled and not state then return end
        if not state or state.Main ~= main or not state.Root.Parent then
            local root = Instance.new("CanvasGroup")
            root.Name, root.Size = "SpiderManBackdrop", UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
            root.BackgroundTransparency, root.BorderSizePixel = 1, 0
            root.ClipsDescendants, root.Active, root.ZIndex = true, false, 2
            root.Parent = main
            local canvas = Instance.new("Frame")
            canvas.Name, canvas.AnchorPoint = "WebGeometry", Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
            canvas.Position, canvas.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), UDim2.fromOffset(B.Width, B.Height)
            canvas.BackgroundColor3, canvas.BorderSizePixel = Color3.fromRGB(12, 14, 19), 0
            canvas.Active, canvas.ZIndex, canvas.Parent = false, 2, root
            local scale = Instance.new("UIScale")
            scale.Parent = canvas
            for index, data in ipairs(B.Lines) do
                local dx, dy = data[3] - data[1], data[4] - data[2]
                local part = Instance.new("Frame")
                part.Name, part.AnchorPoint = "WebStrand" .. index, Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
                part.Position = UDim2.fromOffset((data[1] + data[3]) / 2, (data[2] + data[4]) / 2)
                part.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy), data[5])
                part.Rotation = math.deg(math.atan2(dy, dx))
                part.BackgroundColor3, part.BorderSizePixel = B.Colors[data[6]], 0
                part.Active, part.ZIndex, part.Parent = false, 2, canvas
            end
            local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
            title.Name, title.Position, title.Size = "BackdropWordmark", UDim2.fromOffset(308, 642), UDim2.fromOffset(160, 20)
            title.BackgroundTransparency, title.Text = 1, "ANONIM HUB"
            title.Font, title.TextSize, title.TextColor3 = Enum.Font.Code, 12, Color3.fromRGB(94, 106, 118)
            title.TextXAlignment, title.Active, title.ZIndex, title.Parent = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, false, 2, canvas
            state = {Main = main, Image = image, Root = root, Scale = scale, Enabled = false}
            B.State = state
            local function refresh()
                if not root.Parent then return end
                local size = main.AbsoluteSize
                scale.Scale = math.max((size.X > 0 and size.X or B.Width) / B.Width, (size.Y > 0 and size.Y or B.Height) / B.Height)
                local loaded = false
                pcall(function() loaded = image.Image ~= "" and image.IsLoaded == true end)
                root.Visible = state.Enabled and not loaded
                root.GroupTransparency = image.ImageTransparency
            end
            state.Refresh = refresh
            for _, entry in ipairs({{main, "AbsoluteSize"}, {image, "IsLoaded"}, {image, "Image"}, {image, "ImageTransparency"}}) do
                local ok, connection = pcall(function() return entry[1]:GetPropertyChangedSignal(entry[2]):Connect(refresh) end)
                if ok then table.insert(Library.WindowConnections, connection) end
            end
        end
        state.Enabled = enabled == true
        state.Refresh()
    end
end

function Library:CreateWindow(Settings)
    local Config = Settings or {}
    local Title = Config.Title or "UI"
    local SelectedTheme = GetTheme(Config.Theme)

    Library.ThemeListeners = {}
    Library.WindowConnections = {}

    function Library:OnThemeChanged(callback)
        if type(callback) ~= "function" then
            return function() end
        end
        table.insert(self.ThemeListeners, callback)
        if self.ActiveTheme then
            pcall(callback, self.ActiveTheme, self.MenuStyleActive == true)
        end
        return function()
            for i = #self.ThemeListeners, 1, -1 do
                if self.ThemeListeners[i] == callback then
                    table.remove(self.ThemeListeners, i)
                end
            end
        end
    end

    function Library:EmitThemeChanged(theme, menuStyleActive)
        self.ActiveTheme = theme
        self.MenuStyleActive = menuStyleActive == true
        for _, callback in ipairs(self.ThemeListeners) do
            pcall(callback, theme, self.MenuStyleActive)
        end
    end

    function Library:GetThemes()
        local list = {}
        if isfolder(Library.ThemeFolder) then
            for _, file in pairs(listfiles(Library.ThemeFolder)) do
                if file:sub(-5) == ".json" then
                    table.insert(list, (file:match("([^/]+)%.json$") or file))
                end
            end
        end
        return list
    end
    
    function Library:GetConfigs()
        local list = {}
        if isfolder(Library.ConfigFolder) then
            for _, file in pairs(listfiles(Library.ConfigFolder)) do
                if file:sub(-5) == ".json" then
                    local success, decoded = pcall(function()
                        return HS:JSONDecode(readfile(file))
                    end)
                    if success and type(decoded) == "table" and decoded["Settings_Identifier"] == Title then
                        table.insert(list, file:match("([^/]+)%.json$") or file)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return list
    end

    function Library:SaveConfig(Name)
        local ConfigToSave = {}
        for flag, value in pairs(Library.Flags) do
            if string.sub(flag, 1, 9) ~= "Settings_" then
                ConfigToSave[flag] = value
            end
        end
        ConfigToSave["Settings_Identifier"] = Title
        local json = HS:JSONEncode(ConfigToSave)
        local path = Library.ConfigFolder .. "/" .. Name .. ".json"
        writefile(path, json)
        Library:Notify({Title = "Config Saved", Content = "Successfully saved " .. Name, Duration = 3})
    end

    function Library:LoadConfig(Name)
        local path = Library.ConfigFolder .. "/" .. Name .. ".json"
        if isfile(path) then
            local success, err = pcall(function()
                local json = readfile(path)
                local data = HS:JSONDecode(json)
                for flag, value in pairs(data) do
                    if Library.Items[flag] then
                        task.spawn(function()
                            Library.Items[flag].Set(value)
                        end)
                    end
                end
            end)
            if success then
                Library:Notify({Title = "Config Loaded", Content = "Successfully loaded " .. Name, Duration = 3})
            else
                Library:Notify({Title = "Config Error", Content = "Corrupted JSON file", Duration = 3})
            end
        end
    end

    function Library:DeleteConfig(Name)
        local path = Library.ConfigFolder .. "/" .. Name .. ".json"
        if isfile(path) then
            delfile(path)
            Library:Notify({Title = "Config Deleted", Content = "Deleted " .. Name, Duration = 3})
        end
    end

        local cfgToLoad = readfile(AutoloadPath)

            task.delay(1, function()
                Library:LoadConfig(cfgToLoad)
            end)
        end
    end

    function Library:Notify(Config, ContentArg, DurationArg)
        if type(Config) == "string" then
            Config = {
                Title = Config,
                Content = type(ContentArg) == "string" and ContentArg or "",
                Duration = type(ContentArg) == "number" and ContentArg or DurationArg

            Config = {}
        end

                if NotifHolder and NotifHolder.Parent then

                end
            end)
        end)
    end

    local function AttachTooltip(obj, text)
        obj.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
            local currentWidth = WindowContainer.AbsoluteSize.X > 0 and WindowContainer.AbsoluteSize.X or WindowContainer.Size.X.Offset
            local isVisuallyExpanded = SidebarExpanded and currentWidth >= 420
            if isVisuallyExpanded then
                Tooltip.Visible = false
                return
            end
            Tooltip.Text = text
            Tooltip.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(Mouse.X + 16, Mouse.Y - 11)
            Tooltip.Visible = true
        end)
        obj.MouseMoved:Connect(function()
            Tooltip.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(Mouse.X + 16, Mouse.Y - 11)
        end)
        obj.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
            Tooltip.Visible = false
        end)
        obj.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            Tooltip.Visible = false
        end)
    end

    -- ===== SEARCH (TUM sekmelerde arar; hangi sekmede olursan ol) =====
    local SearchQuery = ""
    local AllTabs = {}
    local BlockSeq = 0

    local SearchPage = Create("ScrollingFrame", {
        Name = "SearchResults",

        Parent = SR_Holder,

        AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        LayoutOrder = 2
    })

    local function SR_UpdateCanvas()
        local maxH = math.max(SR_LeftLayout.AbsoluteContentSize.Y, SR_RightLayout.AbsoluteContentSize.Y)
        SearchPage.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, maxH + 30)
    end
    SR_LeftLayout:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteContentSize"):Connect(SR_UpdateCanvas)
    SR_RightLayout:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteContentSize"):Connect(SR_UpdateCanvas)

    local SR_Empty = Create("TextLabel", {
        Name = "NoResults",
        Parent = SearchPage,
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40),
        Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 10),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Text = "No results",
        Font = Library.GlobalFont,
        TextColor3 = SelectedTheme.TextDark,
        TextSize = 14,
        Visible = false,
        ZIndex = 7,
        ThemeTag = "TextDark"
    })

    local function TextHit(t, q)
        return type(t) == "string" and t ~= "" and string.find(string.lower(t), q, 1, true) ~= nil
    end

    local function ElementHit(obj, q)
        if (obj:IsA("TextLabel") or obj:IsA("TextButton")) and TextHit(obj.Text, q) then
            return true
        end
        for _, c in ipairs(obj:GetChildren()) do
            if (c:IsA("TextLabel") or c:IsA("TextButton")) and TextHit(c.Text, q) then
                return true
            end
        end
        return false
    end

    local function RestoreBlock(blk)
        if not blk.Parent then return end
        local collapsed = blk:GetAttribute("Collapsed") == true
        local content = blk:FindFirstChild("BlockContent")
        local sep = blk:FindFirstChild("BlockSep")
        if content then content.Visible = not collapsed end
        if sep then sep.Visible = not collapsed end
    end

    -- Sekme basligi tasiyan sonuc kutusu (tek sutunlu sekmelerdeki elementler icin)
    local function MakeResultGroup(title)
        local F = Create("Frame", {
            Name = "SearchGroup",
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
            AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
            BackgroundColor3 = Style.Panel,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            ZIndex = 5
        })
        AddCorner(F, 9)
        Create("UIStroke", {Parent = F, Color = Style.Outline, Thickness = 1, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border})
        Create("TextLabel", {
            Name = "GroupTitle",
            Parent = F,
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 34),
            Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 0),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Text = tostring(title),
            Font = Library.GlobalFont,
            TextColor3 = SelectedTheme.Text,
            TextSize = 14,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
            TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
            ZIndex = 7
        })
        Create("Frame", {
            Parent = F,
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1),
            Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 34),
            BackgroundColor3 = Style.Outline,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            ZIndex = 6
        })
        local Content = Create("Frame", {
            Name = "BlockContent",
            Parent = F,
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
            Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 35),
            AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            ZIndex = 5
        })
        Create("UIListLayout", {Parent = Content, SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder, Padding = UDim.new(0, 6)})
        Create("UIPadding", {Parent = Content, PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 8), PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 10), PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 8), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 8)})
        return F, Content
    end

    -- Onceki aramayi tamamen geri al: her sey kendi sekmesine/yerine doner
    local function RestoreSearch()
        local st = SearchState
        if not st then return end
        SearchState = nil
        for i = #st.Moved, 1, -1 do
            local m = st.Moved[i]
            if m.Obj and m.Obj.Parent then
                m.Obj.Parent = m.Parent
                m.Obj.LayoutOrder = m.Order
            end
        end
        for obj, vis in pairs(st.Snapshot) do
            if obj.Parent then obj.Visible = vis end
        end
        for lbl, txt in pairs(st.Titles) do
            if lbl.Parent then lbl.Text = txt end
        end
        for blk in pairs(st.Blocks) do
            RestoreBlock(blk)
        end
        for _, t in ipairs(st.Temp) do
            pcall(function() t:Destroy() end)
        end
    end

    local function ApplySearch()
        local q = string.lower(SearchQuery or "")
        q = q:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")

        RestoreSearch()

        if q == "" then
            SearchPage.Visible = false
            SR_Empty.Visible = false
            if ActiveTab and ActiveTab.Page then
                ActiveTab.Page.Visible = true
                ActiveTab.Page.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
            end
            return
        end

        local st = {Snapshot = {}, Moved = {}, Titles = {}, Blocks = {}, Temp = {}}
        SearchState = st

        local function Snap(o)
            if st.Snapshot[o] == nil then
                st.Snapshot[o] = o.Visible
            end
            return st.Snapshot[o]
        end

        local function FilterList(container, forceShow)
            local any = false
            for _, el in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
                if el:IsA("GuiObject") then
                    local was = Snap(el)
                    local hit = was and (forceShow or ElementHit(el, q))
                    el.Visible = hit and true or false
                    if hit then any = true end
                end
            end
            return any
        end

        local function EstHeight(container)
            local h = 50
            for _, el in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
                if el:IsA("GuiObject") and el.Visible then
                    local y = el.Size.Y.Offset
                    if not y or y <= 0 then y = el.AbsoluteSize.Y end
                    h = h + (y or 30) + 6
                end
            end
            return h
        end

        local seq, hL, hR, found = 0, 0, 0, 0
        local function Place(obj, estH, record)
            seq = seq + 1
            local col
            if hL <= hR then
                col = SR_Left
                hL = hL + estH
            else
                col = SR_Right
                hR = hR + estH
            end
            if record then
                table.insert(st.Moved, {Obj = obj, Parent = obj.Parent, Order = obj.LayoutOrder})
            end
            obj.LayoutOrder = seq
            obj.Parent = col
            found = found + 1
        end

        for _, T in ipairs(AllTabs) do
            local Page = T.Page
            if Page and Page.Parent then
                local Holder = Page:FindFirstChild("ColumnsHolder")

                -- 1) Sekmede dogrudan duran elementler (orn. Fight sekmesi)
                local loose = {}
                for _, el in ipairs(Page:GetChildren()) do
                    if el:IsA("GuiObject") and el ~= Holder and Snap(el) and ElementHit(el, q) then
                        table.insert(loose, el)
                    end
                end
                if #loose > 0 then
                    local grp, content = MakeResultGroup(T.Name)
                    table.insert(st.Temp, grp)
                    for _, el in ipairs(loose) do
                        table.insert(st.Moved, {Obj = el, Parent = el.Parent, Order = el.LayoutOrder})
                        el.Parent = content
                    end
                    Place(grp, EstHeight(content), false)
                end

                -- 2) Bloklar
                if Holder then
                    local blocks = {}
                    for _, col in ipairs(Holder:GetChildren()) do
                        if col:IsA("Frame") then
                            for _, blk in ipairs(col:GetChildren()) do
                                if blk:IsA("Frame") and blk.Name == "Block" then
                                    table.insert(blocks, blk)
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    table.sort(blocks, function(a, b) return (a.LayoutOrder or 0) < (b.LayoutOrder or 0) end)

                    for _, blk in ipairs(blocks) do
                        if Snap(blk) then
                            local header = blk:FindFirstChild("BlockHeader")
                            local titleLbl = header and header:FindFirstChild("BlockTitle")
                            local titleHit = titleLbl and TextHit(titleLbl.Text, q)
                            local content = blk:FindFirstChild("BlockContent")
                            local any = content and FilterList(content, titleHit) or false
                            if titleHit or any then
                                st.Blocks[blk] = true
                                if content then content.Visible = true end
                                local sep = blk:FindFirstChild("BlockSep")
                                if sep then sep.Visible = true end
                                if titleLbl then
                                    st.Titles[titleLbl] = titleLbl.Text
                                    titleLbl.Text = tostring(T.Name) .. "  /  " .. titleLbl.Text
                                end
                                Place(blk, content and EstHeight(content) or 50, true)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        for _, T in ipairs(AllTabs) do
            if T.Page then T.Page.Visible = false end
        end
        SR_Empty.Visible = (found == 0)
        SearchPage.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, 0)
        SearchPage.Visible = true
        SR_UpdateCanvas()
    end

    -- Yazarken her harfte degil, kisa bir bekleme sonrasi ara (kasma olmasin)
    local SearchToken = 0
    SearchInput:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
        SearchQuery = SearchInput.Text
        SearchToken = SearchToken + 1
        local my = SearchToken
        if SearchQuery:gsub("%s", "") == "" then
            ApplySearch()
            return
        end
        task.delay(0.12, function()
            if my == SearchToken then
                ApplySearch()
            end
        end)
    end)

    -- ===== OPEN / CLOSE =====
    -- Acilis: Astra tarzi kisa fade. Kapanis: ANINDA (tusa basinca direkt kapanir).
    local IsOpen = false
    local CurrentFade = nil
    local FadeInfo = TweenInfo.new(0.22, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
    local ToggleCallbacks = {}
    local OpenTweens = {}

    local function FireToggleCallbacks(show)
        for _, fn in ipairs(ToggleCallbacks) do
            task.spawn(pcall, fn, show)
        end
    end

    local function SetWindowOpen(show)
        if show and (Library.WindowClosing or Library.WindowDestroyed) then return end
        IsOpen = show

        if not show then
            -- ANINDA KAPAT: devam eden fade'i iptal et, her seyi direkt gizle
            CurrentFade = nil
            for _, t in ipairs(OpenTweens) do pcall(function() t:Cancel() end) end
            table.clear(OpenTweens)
            Tooltip.Visible = false
            if FadeGroup and Main.Parent == FadeGroup then
                Main.Parent = WindowContainer
            end
            if FadeGroup then
                FadeGroup.Visible = false
                FadeGroup.GroupTransparency = 1
            end
            Shadow1.ImageTransparency = 1
            Shadow2.ImageTransparency = 1
            CloseX.TextTransparency = 1
            CloseX.TextStrokeTransparency = 1
            WindowContainer.Visible = false
            FireToggleCallbacks(false)
            return
        end

        WindowContainer.Visible = true
        FireToggleCallbacks(true)
        table.clear(OpenTweens)
        table.insert(OpenTweens, TS:Create(Shadow1, FadeInfo, {ImageTransparency = 0.55}))
        table.insert(OpenTweens, TS:Create(Shadow2, FadeInfo, {ImageTransparency = 0.6}))
        table.insert(OpenTweens, TS:Create(CloseX, FadeInfo, {TextTransparency = 0, TextStrokeTransparency = 0.7}))
        for _, t in ipairs(OpenTweens) do t:Play() end

        if not FadeGroup then return end

        if Main.Parent ~= FadeGroup then
            FadeGroup.GroupTransparency = 1
            Main.Parent = FadeGroup
        end
        FadeGroup.Visible = true

        local tw = TS:Create(FadeGroup, FadeInfo, {GroupTransparency = 0})
        CurrentFade = tw
        table.insert(OpenTweens, tw)
        tw.Completed:Connect(function()
            if CurrentFade ~= tw then return end
            CurrentFade = nil
            if IsOpen then
                Main.Parent = WindowContainer
                FadeGroup.Visible = false
            end
        end)
        tw:Play()
    end

    local function ToggleUI()
        if Library.WindowClosing or Library.WindowDestroyed then return end
        SetWindowOpen(not IsOpen)
    end

    -- Menu acilip kapandiginda cagrilir: fn(isOpen)
    function Library:OnWindowToggle(fn)
        if type(fn) == "function" then
            table.insert(ToggleCallbacks, fn)
        end
    end

    function Library:IsWindowOpen()
        return IsOpen
    end

    function Library:SetWindowOpen(show)
        SetWindowOpen(show and true or false)
    end

    function Library:CloseWindow()
        if self.WindowDestroyed then return end
        self.WindowClosing = true
        if IsOpen then SetWindowOpen(false) end
    end

    function Library:SetCloseHandler(callback)
        self.CloseHandler = type(callback) == "function" and callback or nil
    end

    function Library:DestroyWindow()
        if self.WindowDestroyed then return end
        self:CloseWindow()
        self.WindowDestroyed = true
        self.CloseHandler = nil
        for _, connection in ipairs(self.WindowConnections or {}) do
            pcall(function() connection:Disconnect() end)
        end
        self.WindowConnections = {}
        if self.SpiderManBackdrop then self.SpiderManBackdrop.State = nil end
        if self.ThemeListeners then table.clear(self.ThemeListeners) end
        table.clear(ToggleCallbacks)
        self.ActiveTheme = nil
        self.MenuStyleActive = false
        pcall(function() ScreenGui:Destroy() end)
    end

    SetWindowOpen(true)

    if UIS.TouchEnabled then
        local MobileBtn = Create("ImageButton", {
            Name = "MobileToggle",
            Parent = ScreenGui,
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(50, 50),
            Position = UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0.5, 0),
            BackgroundColor3 = SelectedTheme.Main,
            BackgroundTransparency = 0.1,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            Image = "rbxassetid://10884488899",
            ImageColor3 = SelectedTheme.Accent,
            ThemeTag = "Main"
        })
        AddCorner(MobileBtn, 14)
        AddStroke(MobileBtn, SelectedTheme)
        MakeDraggable(MobileBtn, MobileBtn)
        CreateDropShadow(MobileBtn, 35, 0.3)
        table.insert(Library.ThemeObjects.Accent, MobileBtn)

        MobileBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(ToggleUI)
    end

    table.insert(Library.WindowConnections, UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gpe)
        if gpe or UIS:GetFocusedTextBox() then
            return
        end

        local currentToggle = Library.ToggleKey
        if Library.Flags["Settings_ToggleKey"] then
            local s, k = pcall(function() return Enum.KeyCode[Library.Flags["Settings_ToggleKey"]] end)
            if s and k then
                currentToggle = k
            end
        end

        if input.KeyCode == currentToggle then
            ToggleUI()
        end
    end))

    function Funcs:CreateTab(TabName, Two_Column, ImageID)
        TabCount = TabCount + 1
        local MyIndex = TabCount
        local Tab = {}

        -- Astra ikonlari: lucide ismi verildiyse onu, yoksa sekme ismine gore otomatik ikon kullan
        local IconRef = ImageID
        if Config.AstraIcons ~= false then
            if not GetLucide(ImageID) then
                local mapped = AstraTabIcons[string.lower(tostring(TabName))]
                if mapped then IconRef = mapped end
            end
        end
        if IconRef == "__PLUS__" then IconRef = "plus" end
        if (IconRef == nil or IconRef == "") and CompactSidebar then IconRef = "layers" end
        local HasIcon = (IconRef ~= nil and IconRef ~= "")
        local TabIconRef = IconRef

        local TabBtn = Create("TextButton", {
            Name = "TabBtn",
            Parent = TabContainer,
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, TAB_H),
            BackgroundColor3 = Style.Element,
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Text = "",
            AutoButtonColor = false,
            LayoutOrder = MyIndex,
            ZIndex = 6
        })
        AddCorner(TabBtn, 6)

        local TabLabel = Create("TextLabel", {
            Name = "TabLabel",
            Parent = TabBtn,
            Visible = SidebarExpanded,
            Size = UDim2.new(1, HasIcon and -42 or -20, 1, 0),
            Position = UDim2.new(0, HasIcon and 36 or 12, 0, 0),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Text = TabName,
            Font = Library.GlobalFont,
            TextColor3 = SelectedTheme.TextDark,
            TextSize = 13,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
            TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
            ZIndex = 7
        })

        local TabIcon
        if HasIcon then
            TabIcon = Create("ImageLabel", {
                Name = "TabIcon",
                Parent = TabBtn,
                Size = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 20),
                AnchorPoint = SidebarExpanded and Vector2.new(0, 0.5) or Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
                Position = SidebarExpanded and UDim2.new(0, 10, 0.5, 0) or UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                ImageColor3 = SelectedTheme.ElementAccent,
                ImageTransparency = 0.45,
                ZIndex = 7
            })
            ApplyIcon(TabIcon, IconRef)
        end
        table.insert(Library.ThemeObjects.TabLabels, {Label = TabLabel, Btn = TabBtn, Icon = TabIcon})

        AttachTooltip(TabBtn, TabName)

        local hoverTweenTab, leaveTweenTab
        TabBtn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
            if ActiveTab and ActiveTab.Btn ~= TabBtn then
                if leaveTweenTab then leaveTweenTab:Cancel() end
                hoverTweenTab = TS:Create(TabBtn, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {BackgroundTransparency = 0.6})
                hoverTweenTab:Play()
                if TabIcon then TS:Create(TabIcon, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {ImageTransparency = 0.15}):Play() end
            end
        end)
        TabBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
            if ActiveTab and ActiveTab.Btn ~= TabBtn then
                if hoverTweenTab then hoverTweenTab:Cancel() end
                leaveTweenTab = TS:Create(TabBtn, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {BackgroundTransparency = 1})
                leaveTweenTab:Play()
                if TabIcon then TS:Create(TabIcon, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {ImageTransparency = 0.45}):Play() end
            end
        end)

        local Page = Create("ScrollingFrame", {
            Parent = PageContainer,
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            ScrollBarThickness = 3,
            ScrollBarImageColor3 = SelectedTheme.TextDark,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            Visible = false,
            CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0),
            ZIndex = 6
        })
        
        table.insert(AllTabs, {Name = TabName, Page = Page})
        local LeftCol, RightCol
        if Two_Column then
            local ColumnsHolder = Create("Frame", {
                Name = "ColumnsHolder",
                Parent = Page,
                Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0),
                AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
                BackgroundTransparency = 1
            })
            
            Create("UIListLayout", {
                Parent = ColumnsHolder,
                FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal,
                SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
                Padding = UDim.new(0, 10)
            })
            
            Create("UIPadding", {
                Parent = ColumnsHolder,
                PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 2),
                PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 5),
                PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 10),
                PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 15)
            })
            
            LeftCol = Create("Frame", {
                Parent = ColumnsHolder,
                Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -5, 0, 0),
                AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                LayoutOrder = 1
            })
            
            local LeftLayout = Create("UIListLayout", {
                Parent = LeftCol,
                SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
                Padding = UDim.new(0, 10)
            })
            
            RightCol = Create("Frame", {
                Parent = ColumnsHolder,
                Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -5, 0, 0),
                AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                LayoutOrder = 2
            })
            
            local RightLayout = Create("UIListLayout", {
                Parent = RightCol,
                SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
                Padding = UDim.new(0, 10)
            })
            
            local function UpdateCanvasSize()
                local maxH = math.max(LeftLayout.AbsoluteContentSize.Y, RightLayout.AbsoluteContentSize.Y)
                Page.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, maxH + 30)
            end
            
            LeftLayout:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteContentSize"):Connect(UpdateCanvasSize)
            RightLayout:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteContentSize"):Connect(UpdateCanvasSize)
        else
            local Layout = Create("UIListLayout", {
                Parent = Page,
                Padding = UDim.new(0, 8),
                SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
            }) 
            
            Create("UIPadding", {
                Parent = Page,
                PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 2),
                PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 5),
                PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 12),
                PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 15)
            })
            
            Layout:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteContentSize"):Connect(function()
                Page.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, Layout.AbsoluteContentSize.Y + 30)
            end)
        end

        local function Activate()
            if ActiveTab and ActiveTab.Btn == TabBtn then
                if SearchState then
                    SearchInput.Text = ""
                    SearchQuery = ""
                    ApplySearch()
                end
                return
            end

            local OldTab = ActiveTab
            local Direction = (OldTab and MyIndex > OldTab.Index) and "Down" or "Up"
            ActiveTab = {Btn = TabBtn, Page = Page, Index = MyIndex, Name = TabName}

            for _, v in pairs(TabContainer:GetChildren()) do
                if v:IsA("TextButton") then
                    TS:Create(v, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()
                    local lbl = v:FindFirstChild("TabLabel")
                    local icon = v:FindFirstChild("TabIcon")
                    if lbl then
                        TS:Create(lbl, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {TextColor3 = SelectedTheme.TextDark}):Play()
                    end
                    if icon then
                        TS:Create(icon, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {ImageTransparency = 0.45}):Play()
                    end
                end
            end

            -- Gizli "Settings" sekmesi acilinca disli butonu secili gorunur
            local SelBtn = TabBtn
            SettingsIsActive = (TabName == "Settings")
            if SettingsIsActive and OpenSettingsBtn then
                SelBtn = OpenSettingsBtn
            end

            TS:Create(SelBtn, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {BackgroundTransparency = 0}):Play()
            local SelLabel = SelBtn:FindFirstChild("TabLabel")
            local SelIcon = SelBtn:FindFirstChild("TabIcon")
            if SelLabel then
                TS:Create(SelLabel, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {TextColor3 = SelectedTheme.Text}):Play()
            end
            if SelIcon then
                TS:Create(SelIcon, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {ImageTransparency = 0}):Play()
            end

            if OldTab then
                local OldPage = OldTab.Page
                local OutPos = (Direction == "Down") and UDim2.new(0, 0, -1, 0) or UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
                TS:Create(OldPage, TweenInfo.new(0.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Position = OutPos}):Play()
                task.delay(0.4, function()
                    if ActiveTab.Page ~= OldPage then
                        OldPage.Visible = false
                    end
                end)
            end

            Page.Visible = true
            Page.Position = (Direction == "Down") and UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0) or (Direction == "Up" and UDim2.new(0, 0, -1, 0) or UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0))
            if Direction ~= "None" then
                TS:Create(Page, TweenInfo.new(0.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)}):Play()
            end

            -- Arama acikken sekmeye tiklanirsa arama temizlenir ve o sekme acilir
            if SearchQuery ~= "" or SearchState then
                SearchInput.Text = ""
                SearchQuery = ""
                ApplySearch()
            end
        end
        
        TabBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(Activate)
        
        if MyIndex == 1 then
            Activate()
        end

        local function GetElements(TargetParent)
            local Elements = {}
            local ElementOrder = 0

            local function DefaultHover(btn)
                local hoverTween, leaveTween
                btn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
                    if leaveTween then leaveTween:Cancel() end
                    hoverTween = TS:Create(btn, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {BackgroundTransparency = 0.3})
                    hoverTween:Play()
                end)
                btn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
                    if hoverTween then hoverTween:Cancel() end
                    leaveTween = TS:Create(btn, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {BackgroundTransparency = 0.5})
                    leaveTween:Play()
                end)
            end

            function Elements:CreateSection(Text)
                ElementOrder = ElementOrder + 1
                local Lab = Create("TextLabel", {
                    Parent = TargetParent,
                    Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20),
                    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                    Text = Text,
                    Font = Library.GlobalFontBold,
                    TextColor3 = SelectedTheme.Text,
                    TextSize = 13,
                    TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
                    LayoutOrder = ElementOrder,
                    ZIndex = 8,
                    ThemeTag = "Text"
                })
                Create("UIPadding", { Parent = Lab, PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 6) })
            end

            -- Ayirici: ----- Yazi -----  (Astra/Obsidian tarzi)
            function Elements:CreateDivider(Text)
                ElementOrder = ElementOrder + 1
                if type(Text) == "table" then Text = Text.Text or Text.Name end
                local Holder = Create("Frame", {
                    Parent = TargetParent,
                    Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, (Text and Text ~= "") and 18 or 8),
                    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                    LayoutOrder = ElementOrder,
                    ZIndex = 7
                })
                local LineColor = Library.Style and Library.Style.Outline or Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40)
                local LineL = Create("Frame", {
                    Name = "DividerLine",
                    Parent = Holder,
                    AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5),
                    Position = UDim2.new(0, 2, 0.5, 0),
                    Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 1),
                    BackgroundColor3 = LineColor,
                    BackgroundTransparency = 0.3,
                    BorderSizePixel = 0,
                    ZIndex = 8
                })
                if not Text or Text == "" then
                    return Holder
                end
                local LineR = Create("Frame", {
                    Name = "DividerLine",
                    Parent = Holder,
                    AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
                    Position = UDim2.new(1, -2, 0.5, 0),
                    Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -40, 0, 1),
                    BackgroundColor3 = LineColor,
                    BackgroundTransparency = 0.3,
                    BorderSizePixel = 0,
                    ZIndex = 8
                })
                local Lbl = Create("TextLabel", {
                    Parent = Holder,
                    AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
                    Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
                    Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0),
                    AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
                    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                    Text = tostring(Text),
                    Font = Library.GlobalFont,
                    TextColor3 = SelectedTheme.TextDark,
                    TextSize = 12,
                    ZIndex = 8,
                    ThemeTag = "TextDark"
                })
                local function Relayout()
                    local w = Lbl.AbsoluteSize.X
                    if w <= 0 then w = (#Lbl.Text * 7) end
                    LineL.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -(w / 2 + 8), 0, 1)
                    LineR.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -(w / 2 + 8), 0, 1)
                end
                Lbl:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(Relayout)
                Relayout()
                return Holder, Lbl
            end
