        local function capturePalette(theme)
            local palette = {}
            for _, key in ipairs(paletteKeys) do
                palette[key] = theme[key]
            end
            palette.Font = Library.GlobalFont.Name
            palette.CornerRadius = Library.GlobalCornerValue
            palette.Transparency = MainBgColor.BackgroundTransparency
            palette.ImageTransparency = MainBgImage.ImageTransparency
            palette.OrbsTransparency = OrbsTrans
            return palette
        end

        local function syncColorPicker(flag, color)
            local item = Library.Items[flag]
            if item and item.Set and color then
                pcall(item.Set, color)
            end
        end

        local function setMenuStyleArt(preset, theme, enabled)
            local root = WindowContainer:FindFirstChild("MenuStyleArt")
            if not root then return end
            root.Visible = enabled == true
            for _, child in ipairs(root:GetChildren()) do
                child:Destroy()
            end
            if not enabled then return end

            local characters = preset and preset.Characters or {}
            local decorations = preset and preset.Decorations or {}
            local mobile = IsMobile
            local currentHeight = math.max(WindowContainer.AbsoluteSize.Y, WindowContainer.Size.Y.Offset)

            for index, character in ipairs(characters) do
                local placement = character.Placement or (index == 1 and "Left" or "Right")
                local width = mobile and (character.MobileWidth or 84) or (character.Width or 108)
                local height = mobile and (character.MobileHeight or width) or (character.Height or width)
                local anchor = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
                local position

                if placement == "Top" then
                    anchor = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
                    position = UDim2.new(0.5, character.XOffset or 0, 0, mobile and (character.MobileBottomOffset or 26) or (character.BottomOffset or 32))
                elseif placement == "TopHang" then
                    anchor = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
                    position = UDim2.new(
                        mobile and (character.MobileXScale or character.XScale or 0.5) or (character.XScale or 0.5),
                        mobile and (character.MobileXOffset or character.XOffset or 0) or (character.XOffset or 0),
                        0,
                        mobile and (character.MobileTopOffset or -10) or (character.TopOffset or -12)
                    )
                elseif placement == "Left" then
                    position = UDim2.new(0, mobile and -(width * 0.18) or -(width * 0.5), 0, currentHeight * (character.HeightRatio or 0.34))
                elseif placement == "Right" then
                    position = UDim2.new(1, mobile and (character.MobileSideOffset or 16) or (character.SideOffset or 36), 0, currentHeight * (character.HeightRatio or 0.34))
                else
                    position = UDim2.new(0.5, character.XOffset or 0, 0, currentHeight * (character.HeightRatio or 0.34))
                end

                Create("ImageLabel", {
                    Name = "Character_" .. tostring(character.Name or index),
                    Parent = root,
                    AnchorPoint = anchor,
                    Position = position,
                    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width, height),
                    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                    Image = character.Image or "",
                    ImageColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
                    ImageTransparency = character.ImageTransparency or 0,
                    ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit,
                    Active = false,
                    ZIndex = 22
                })
            end

            for index, decoration in ipairs(decorations) do
                local xScale = mobile and (decoration.MobileXScale or decoration.XScale or 0.5) or (decoration.XScale or 0.5)
                local yOffset = mobile and (decoration.MobileYOffset or decoration.YOffset or 0) or (decoration.YOffset or 0)
                if decoration.Kind == "Parachute" then
                    local width = mobile and (decoration.MobileWidth or 38) or (decoration.Width or 52)
                    local height = mobile and (decoration.MobileHeight or 52) or (decoration.Height or 70)
                    local holder = Create("Frame", {
                        Name = "Decoration_" .. tostring(decoration.Name or index),
                        Parent = root,
                        AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0),
                        Position = UDim2.new(xScale, 0, 0, yOffset),
                        Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width, height),
                        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                        ZIndex = 21
                    })
                    local canopy = Create("Frame", {
                        Name = "Canopy",
                        Parent = holder,
                        Position = UDim2.new(0.12, 0, 0, 2),
                        Size = UDim2.new(0.76, 0, 0.30, 0),
                        BackgroundColor3 = decoration.CanopyColor or Color3.fromRGB(255, 238, 187),
                        BorderSizePixel = 0,
                        ZIndex = 22
                    })
                    AddCorner(canopy, 24)
                    Create("UIStroke", {Parent = canopy, Color = Style.Outline, Thickness = 1})
                    Create("Frame", {
                        Parent = holder,
                        Position = UDim2.new(0.28, 0, 0.27, 0),
                        Size = UDim2.new(0, 1, 0, height * 0.30),
                        Rotation = -15,
                        BackgroundColor3 = Style.Outline,
                        BorderSizePixel = 0,
                        ZIndex = 22
                    })
                    Create("Frame", {
                        Parent = holder,
                        Position = UDim2.new(0.72, 0, 0.27, 0),
                        Size = UDim2.new(0, 1, 0, height * 0.30),
                        Rotation = 15,
                        BackgroundColor3 = Style.Outline,
                        BorderSizePixel = 0,
                        ZIndex = 22
                    })
                    Create("ImageLabel", {
                        Name = "Toy",
                        Parent = holder,
                        AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0),
                        Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.55, 0),
                        Size = UDim2.new(0.50, 0, 0.43, 0),
                        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                        Image = decoration.Image or "",
                        ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit,
                        ZIndex = 23
                    })
                elseif decoration.Kind == "Symbol" then
                    local size = mobile and (decoration.MobileSize or 18) or (decoration.Size or 24)
                    Create("TextLabel", {
                        Name = "Decoration_" .. tostring(decoration.Name or index),
                        Parent = root,
                        AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
                        Position = UDim2.new(xScale, 0, 0, yOffset),
                        Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size + 10, size + 10),
                        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                        Text = decoration.Text or "✦",
                        Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack,
                        TextSize = size,
                        TextColor3 = decoration.Color or (theme and theme.ElementAccent) or Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
                        TextStrokeColor3 = Style.Outline,
                        TextStrokeTransparency = 0.25,
                        ZIndex = 21
                    })
                end
            end
        end

        local baseShellStyle = {
            Background = Style.Background,
            Panel = Style.Panel,
            Element = Style.Element,
            Outline = Style.Outline,
            Icon = Style.Icon
        }
        local baseWindowTransparency = MainBgColor.BackgroundTransparency

        local function applyShellStyle(preset, enabled)
            local pastelShellActive = enabled == true and preset ~= nil and preset.Shell ~= nil
            local referenceShell = pastelShellActive and preset.Variant == "SpiderMan"
            Library.MenuStyleShellActive = pastelShellActive
            if OrbContainer then OrbContainer.Visible = not pastelShellActive end
            local shell = pastelShellActive and preset.Shell or baseShellStyle
            for key, value in pairs(baseShellStyle) do
                Style[key] = shell[key] or value
            end

            Main.BackgroundColor3 = SelectedTheme.Main
            MainBgColor.BackgroundColor3 = SelectedTheme.Main
            MainBgColor.ZIndex = referenceShell and 0 or 2
            MainBgColor.BackgroundTransparency = (enabled and preset and preset.Window and preset.Window.BackgroundTransparency ~= nil)
                and preset.Window.BackgroundTransparency or (SelectedTheme.Transparency or baseWindowTransparency)

            local backgroundImage = SelectedTheme.Background
            if enabled and not referenceShell and preset and preset.Palette and preset.Palette.Background ~= nil then
                backgroundImage = preset.Palette.Background
            end
            SetImageAsync(MainBgImage, "Image", backgroundImage)
            Library.SpiderManBackdrop.SetEnabled(Main, MainBgImage, referenceShell)

            if MainOutline then MainOutline.Color = referenceShell and preset.Shell.Edge or Style.Outline end
            if SearchFrame then SearchFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Style.Element end
            if SearchStroke then SearchStroke.Color = SelectedTheme.ElementAccent end
            if MoveIcon then MoveIcon.ImageColor3 = Style.Icon end
            if ResizeBtn then ResizeBtn.ImageColor3 = Style.Icon end
            if CloseX then
                CloseX.TextColor3 = enabled and Style.Icon or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
            end
            if Tooltip then Tooltip.BackgroundColor3 = Style.Element end
            if TooltipStroke then TooltipStroke.Color = Style.Outline end
            if OpenSettingsBtn then OpenSettingsBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Style.Element end

            local function ApplySidebarLayout()
                local currentWidth = WindowContainer.AbsoluteSize.X > 0 and WindowContainer.AbsoluteSize.X or WindowContainer.Size.X.Offset
                local expandedSidebar = SidebarExpanded and currentWidth >= 420
                local availableWidth = math.max(CompactSidebarWidth, currentWidth - 250)
                SidebarWidth = expandedSidebar and math.min(ExpandedSidebarWidth, availableWidth) or CompactSidebarWidth

                if Tooltip and expandedSidebar then Tooltip.Visible = false end
                if TabContainer then
                    TabContainer.Size = UDim2.new(0, SidebarWidth, 1, -(TOPBAR_H + FOOTER_H + 1))
                    TabContainer.BackgroundColor3 = Style.Panel
                    TabContainer.BackgroundTransparency = (pastelShellActive and not referenceShell) and 0.12 or 1
                end
                if SideDivider then
                    SideDivider.Position = UDim2.new(0, SidebarWidth, 0, 0)
                end
                if SidebarResizeHandle then
                    SidebarResizeHandle.Position = UDim2.new(0, SidebarWidth - 5, 0, TOPBAR_H + 1)
                    SidebarResizeHandle.Size = UDim2.new(0, 10, 1, -(TOPBAR_H + FOOTER_H + 2))
                end
                if PageContainer then
                    PageContainer.Size = UDim2.new(1, -(SidebarWidth + 8 + 6), 1, -(TOPBAR_H + FOOTER_H + 14))
                    PageContainer.Position = UDim2.new(0, SidebarWidth + 8, 0, TOPBAR_H + 8)
                end
                if SearchFrame then
                    SearchFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, SidebarWidth + 8, 0.5, 0)
                    SearchFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, -(SidebarWidth + 8 + 44), 0, 30)
                end
                if LogoIcon then
                    LogoIcon.AnchorPoint = expandedSidebar and Vector2.new(0, 0.5) or Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
                    LogoIcon.Position = expandedSidebar and UDim2.new(0, 14, 0.5, 0) or UDim2.new(0, SidebarWidth / 2, 0.5, 0)
                end
                if WindowTitle then
                    WindowTitle.Visible = expandedSidebar
                    WindowTitle.Size = UDim2.new(0, SidebarWidth - 54, 1, 0)
                    WindowTitle.Position = UDim2.new(0, 48, 0, 0)
                    WindowTitle.TextSize = (pastelShellActive and not referenceShell) and 15 or 14
                end
                if SettingsGear then
                    SettingsGear.AnchorPoint = expandedSidebar and Vector2.new(0, 0.5) or Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
                    SettingsGear.Position = expandedSidebar and UDim2.new(0, 10, 0.5, 0) or UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
                end
                if SettingsLabel then
                    SettingsLabel.Visible = expandedSidebar
                    SettingsLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 1, 0)
                    SettingsLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 36, 0, 0)
                    SettingsLabel.TextSize = (pastelShellActive and not referenceShell) and 14 or 13
                end
                if TabContainer then
                    for _, tabButton in ipairs(TabContainer:GetChildren()) do
                        if tabButton:IsA("TextButton") then
                            local label = tabButton:FindFirstChild("TabLabel")
                            local icon = tabButton:FindFirstChild("TabIcon")
                            if label then
                                label.Visible = expandedSidebar
                                if expandedSidebar then
                                    label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -42, 1, 0)
                                    label.Position = UDim2.new(0, 36, 0, 0)
                                    label.TextSize = (pastelShellActive and not referenceShell) and 14 or 13
                                else
                                    label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -42, 1, 0)
                                    label.Position = UDim2.new(0, 36, 0, 0)
                                    label.TextSize = 13
                                end
                            end
                            if icon then
                                icon.AnchorPoint = expandedSidebar and Vector2.new(0, 0.5) or Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
                                icon.Position = expandedSidebar and UDim2.new(0, 10, 0.5, 0) or UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
                            end
                            local selected = (ActiveTab and ActiveTab.Btn == tabButton) or (SettingsIsActive and tabButton == OpenSettingsBtn)
                            tabButton.BackgroundColor3 = Style.Element
                            tabButton.BackgroundTransparency = selected and 0 or 1
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            ApplySidebarLayout()
            refreshWindowLayout = ApplySidebarLayout

            for _, obj in ipairs(Main:GetDescendants()) do
                if obj:IsA("Frame") or obj:IsA("TextButton") then
                    if obj.Name == "Block" or obj.Name == "SearchGroup" then
                        obj.BackgroundColor3 = Style.Panel
                        if obj.Name == "Block" then obj.BackgroundTransparency = referenceShell and 0.20 or 0 end
                    elseif obj.Name == "BlockSep" or obj.Name == "TopDivider" or obj.Name == "SideDivider"
                        or obj.Name == "FooterDivider" or obj.Name == "DividerLine" then
                        obj.BackgroundColor3 = Style.Outline
                    elseif obj.Name == "Search" or obj.Name == "TabBtn" or obj.Name == "SettingsBtn" or obj.Name == "Tooltip" then
                        obj.BackgroundColor3 = Style.Element
                    end
                elseif obj:IsA("UIStroke") then
                    local parent = obj.Parent
                    if parent == Main then
                        obj.Color = referenceShell and preset.Shell.Edge or Style.Outline
                    elseif parent and (parent.Name == "Block" or parent.Name == "SearchGroup" or parent.Name == "Tooltip") then
                        obj.Color = Style.Outline
                    elseif parent and parent.Name == "Search" then
                        obj.Color = SelectedTheme.ElementAccent
                    end
                end
            end


        end

        -- Initialize the responsive sidebar layout once; later resize/style changes reuse it.
        applyShellStyle(nil, false)

        local sidebarDragging = false
        local sidebarDragStartX = nil
        local sidebarDragMoved = false

        local function refreshSidebarLayout()
            if refreshWindowLayout then
                refreshWindowLayout()
            end
        end

        SidebarResizeHandle.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                sidebarDragging = true
                sidebarDragStartX = input.Position.X
                sidebarDragMoved = false
            end
        end)

        local sidebarInputChanged = UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
            if not sidebarDragging then return end
            if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                return
            end

            local deltaX = math.abs(input.Position.X - (sidebarDragStartX or input.Position.X))
            if deltaX > 4 then sidebarDragMoved = true end
            local requestedWidth = input.Position.X - Main.AbsolutePosition.X
            if requestedWidth < 94 then
                SidebarExpanded = false
            else
                SidebarExpanded = true
                ExpandedSidebarWidth = math.clamp(requestedWidth, 120, 240)
            end
            refreshSidebarLayout()
        end)
        local sidebarInputEnded = UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                sidebarDragging = false
                sidebarDragStartX = nil
            end
        end)
        table.insert(Library.WindowConnections, sidebarInputChanged)
        table.insert(Library.WindowConnections, sidebarInputEnded)

        SidebarResizeHandle.Activated:Connect(function()
            if sidebarDragMoved then
                sidebarDragMoved = false
                return
            end
            SidebarExpanded = not SidebarExpanded
            refreshSidebarLayout()
        end)

        local function applyPalette(palette, menuStyleActive, preset)
            local nextTheme = {}
            for key, value in pairs(SelectedTheme) do
                nextTheme[key] = value
            end
            for key, value in pairs(palette) do
                nextTheme[key] = value
                Themes.Default[key] = value
            end
            local reference = menuStyleActive == true and preset and preset.Variant == "SpiderMan"
            nextTheme.MenuVariant = reference and "SpiderMan" or nil
            nextTheme.Outline = reference and preset.Shell.Outline or nil
            if reference then nextTheme.Background = Library.SpiderManBackdrop.Resolve() end
            Themes.Default.Background = nextTheme.Background
            nextTheme.Gradient = GetGradientSeq(nextTheme)
            Themes.Default.Gradient = nextTheme.Gradient
            SelectedTheme = nextTheme
            Library.MenuStyleActive = menuStyleActive == true

            Main.BackgroundColor3 = nextTheme.Main
            MainBgColor.BackgroundColor3 = nextTheme.Main
            applyShellStyle(preset, menuStyleActive)
            UpdateThemeObjects()
            UpdateGradients(nextTheme.Gradient)
            if nextTheme.Font then UpdateFonts(nextTheme.Font) end
            if nextTheme.CornerRadius ~= nil then UpdateCorners(nextTheme.CornerRadius) end
            if nextTheme.ImageTransparency ~= nil then MainBgImage.ImageTransparency = nextTheme.ImageTransparency end
            if nextTheme.OrbsTransparency ~= nil then
                OrbsTrans = nextTheme.OrbsTransparency
                for _, orb in ipairs(OrbContainer:GetChildren()) do
                    if orb:IsA("Frame") then orb.BackgroundTransparency = OrbsTrans end
                end
            end
            syncColorPicker("Settings_Font", nextTheme.Font)
            syncColorPicker("Settings_CornerRadius", nextTheme.CornerRadius)
            syncColorPicker("Settings_ImageTrans", nextTheme.ImageTransparency and math.floor(nextTheme.ImageTransparency * 100 + 0.5))
            syncColorPicker("Settings_BgTrans", math.floor(MainBgColor.BackgroundTransparency * 100 + 0.5))
            syncColorPicker("Settings_OrbTrans", math.floor(OrbsTrans * 100 + 0.5))

            syncColorPicker("Settings_MainColor", nextTheme.Main)
            syncColorPicker("Settings_SecondColor", nextTheme.Second)
            syncColorPicker("Settings_ElementColor", nextTheme.ElementAccent)
            syncColorPicker("Settings_TextColor", nextTheme.Text)
            syncColorPicker("Settings_GradStart", nextTheme.GradientStart or nextTheme.Accent)
            syncColorPicker("Settings_GradEnd", nextTheme.GradientEnd or nextTheme.Accent)

            if reference and preset.Characters[1] then
                preset.Characters[1].Image = Library.SpiderManBackdrop.ResolveHero()
            end
            setMenuStyleArt(preset, nextTheme, menuStyleActive)
            Library:EmitThemeChanged(nextTheme, menuStyleActive)
        end

        local function applySelectedMenuStyle()
            local preset = MENU_STYLE_PRESETS[selectedMenuStyle]
            if not preset then return end
            local base = themeBeforeMenuStyle or capturePalette(SelectedTheme)
            local palette = {}
            for key, value in pairs(base) do
                palette[key] = value
            end
            for key, value in pairs(preset.Palette) do
                palette[key] = value
            end
            applyPalette(palette, true, preset)
        end

        local MenuStyleBlock = SettingsTab:CreateBlock({Name = "Menu Style", Side = "Right"})
        MenuStyleBlock:CreateToggle({
            Name = "Enable",
            Flag = "Settings_MenuStyleEnabled",
            Default = false,
            Callback = function(value)
                menuStyleEnabled = value == true
                if menuStyleEnabled then
                    themeBeforeMenuStyle = capturePalette(SelectedTheme)
                    applySelectedMenuStyle()
                else
                    if themeBeforeMenuStyle then
                        applyPalette(themeBeforeMenuStyle, false, nil)
                    else
                        setMenuStyleArt(nil, SelectedTheme, false)
                        Library:EmitThemeChanged(SelectedTheme, false)
                    end
                    themeBeforeMenuStyle = nil
                end
            end
        })
        local styleDropdown = MenuStyleBlock:CreateDropdown({
            Name = "Style",
            Flag = "Settings_MenuStyle",
            Items = MENU_STYLE_NAMES,
            Default = selectedMenuStyle,
            Callback = function(value)
                if value and MENU_STYLE_PRESETS[value] then
                    selectedMenuStyle = value
                    if menuStyleEnabled then
                        applySelectedMenuStyle()
                    end
                end
            end
        })
        local originalStyleSet = styleDropdown.Set
        styleDropdown.Set = function(value)
            return originalStyleSet(value == "Obsidian Cyan" and "Spider-Man" or value)
        end
    end

    local KeyBlock = SettingsTab:CreateBlock({Name = "Keybinds", Side = "Left"})
    
    KeyBlock:CreateKeybind({
        Name = "Toggle UI",
        Flag = "Settings_ToggleKey",
        Default = Library.ToggleKey,
        Callback = function() end
    })

    local ConfigBlock = SettingsTab:CreateBlock({Name = "Config Manager", Side = "Left"})

    local ConfigNameInput = "MyConfig"
    ConfigBlock:CreateInput({
        Name = "Config Name",
        Flag = "Settings_CfgName",
        Default = "MyConfig",
        Callback = function(v)
            ConfigNameInput = v
        end
    })
    
    ConfigBlock:CreateButton({
        Name = "Save Config",
        Callback = function()
            Library:SaveConfig(ConfigNameInput)
        end
    })

    local LoadDropCfg = ConfigBlock:CreateDropdown({
        Name = "Load Config",
        Flag = "Settings_CfgLoad",
        Items = Library:GetConfigs(),
        UpdateList = function()
            return Library:GetConfigs()
        end,
        Callback = function(val)
            Library:LoadConfig(val)
            if Library.Flags["Settings_AutoLoadToggle"] then
                writefile(AutoloadPath, val)
            end
        end
    })

    ConfigBlock:CreateButton({
        Name = "Delete Selected Config",
        Callback = function()
            local sel = LoadDropCfg:Get()
            if sel and isfile(Library.ConfigFolder .. "/" .. sel .. ".json") then
                Library:DeleteConfig(sel)
            end
        end
    })

    local currentAutoLoad = ""
    if isfile(AutoloadPath) then
        currentAutoLoad = readfile(AutoloadPath)
    end

    ConfigBlock:CreateToggle({
        Name = "Auto Load Selected Config",
        Flag = "Settings_AutoLoadToggle",
        Default = true,
        Callback = function(val)
            if val then
                local sel = LoadDropCfg:Get()
                if sel then
                    writefile(AutoloadPath, sel)
                end
            else
                if isfile(AutoloadPath) then
                    delfile(AutoloadPath)
                end
            end
        end
    })

    local ColorBlock = SettingsTab:CreateBlock({Name = "Theme Colors", Side = "Right"})
    
    ColorBlock:CreateColorPicker({
        Name = "MainColor",
        Flag = "Settings_MainColor",
        Default = SelectedTheme.Main,
        Callback = function(c)
            SelectedTheme.Main = c
            Themes.Default.Main = c
            UpdateThemeObjects()
            Library:EmitThemeChanged(SelectedTheme, Library.MenuStyleActive == true)
        end
    }) 
    
    ColorBlock:CreateColorPicker({
        Name = "Second Color",
        Flag = "Settings_SecondColor",
        Default = SelectedTheme.Second,
        Callback = function(c)
            SelectedTheme.Second = c
            Themes.Default.Second = c
            UpdateThemeObjects()
            Library:EmitThemeChanged(SelectedTheme, Library.MenuStyleActive == true)
        end
    })
    
    ColorBlock:CreateColorPicker({
        Name = "Element Color",
        Flag = "Settings_ElementColor",
        Default = SelectedTheme.ElementAccent,
        Callback = function(c)
            SelectedTheme.ElementAccent = c
            Themes.Default.ElementAccent = c
            UpdateThemeObjects()
            Library:EmitThemeChanged(SelectedTheme, Library.MenuStyleActive == true)
        end
    })
    
    ColorBlock:CreateColorPicker({
        Name = "Text Color",
        Flag = "Settings_TextColor",
        Default = SelectedTheme.Text,
        Callback = function(c) 
            SelectedTheme.Text = c
            Themes.Default.Text = c
            UpdateThemeObjects()
            Library:EmitThemeChanged(SelectedTheme, Library.MenuStyleActive == true)
        end
    })
    
    ColorBlock:CreateColorPicker({
        Name = "Gradient Start",
        Flag = "Settings_GradStart",
        Default = SelectedTheme.GradientStart or SelectedTheme.Accent,
        Callback = function(c)
            SelectedTheme.GradientStart = c
            SelectedTheme.Gradient = GetGradientSeq(SelectedTheme)
            UpdateGradients(SelectedTheme.Gradient)
            Library:EmitThemeChanged(SelectedTheme, Library.MenuStyleActive == true)
        end
    })
    
    ColorBlock:CreateColorPicker({
        Name = "Gradient End",
        Flag = "Settings_GradEnd",
        Default = SelectedTheme.GradientEnd or SelectedTheme.Accent,
        Callback = function(c)
            SelectedTheme.GradientEnd = c
            SelectedTheme.Gradient = GetGradientSeq(SelectedTheme)
            UpdateGradients(SelectedTheme.Gradient)
            Library:EmitThemeChanged(SelectedTheme, Library.MenuStyleActive == true)
        end
    })

    local ThemeBlock = SettingsTab:CreateBlock({Name = "Theme Manager", Side = "Right"})
    
    local ThemeNameInput = "MyTheme"
    ThemeBlock:CreateInput({
        Name = "Theme Name",
        Flag = "Settings_ThemeName",
        Default = "MyTheme",
        Callback = function(v)
            ThemeNameInput = v
        end
    })
    
    ThemeBlock:CreateButton({
        Name = "Save Theme",
        Callback = function()
            local ThemeConfig = {
                Main = {R = SelectedTheme.Main.R, G = SelectedTheme.Main.G, B = SelectedTheme.Main.B},
                Second = {R = SelectedTheme.Second.R, G = SelectedTheme.Second.G, B = SelectedTheme.Second.B},
                Accent = {R = SelectedTheme.Accent.R, G = SelectedTheme.Accent.G, B = SelectedTheme.Accent.B},
                ElementAccent = {R = SelectedTheme.ElementAccent.R, G = SelectedTheme.ElementAccent.G, B = SelectedTheme.ElementAccent.B},
                Text = {R = SelectedTheme.Text.R, G = SelectedTheme.Text.G, B = SelectedTheme.Text.B},
                TextDark = {R = SelectedTheme.TextDark.R, G = SelectedTheme.TextDark.G, B = SelectedTheme.TextDark.B},
                Error = {R = SelectedTheme.Error.R, G = SelectedTheme.Error.G, B = SelectedTheme.Error.B},
                GradientStart = {R = SelectedTheme.GradientStart.R, G = SelectedTheme.GradientStart.G, B = SelectedTheme.GradientStart.B},
                GradientEnd = {R = SelectedTheme.GradientEnd.R, G = SelectedTheme.GradientEnd.G, B = SelectedTheme.GradientEnd.B},
                Background = SelectedTheme.Background,
                Transparency = MainBgColor.BackgroundTransparency,
                ImageTransparency = MainBgImage.ImageTransparency,
                OrbsTransparency = OrbsTrans,
                Font = Library.GlobalFont.Name,
                CornerRadius = Library.GlobalCornerValue
            }
            writefile(Library.ThemeFolder .. "/" .. ThemeNameInput .. ".json", HS:JSONEncode(ThemeConfig))
            Library:Notify({Title = "Theme Saved", Content = "Saved as " .. ThemeNameInput})
        end
    })

    local LoadDrop = ThemeBlock:CreateDropdown({
        Name = "Load Theme",
        Flag = "Settings_ThemeLoad",
        Items = Library:GetThemes(),
        UpdateList = function()
            return Library:GetThemes()
        end,
        Callback = function(val)
            local NewTheme = GetTheme(val)
            MainBgColor.BackgroundColor3 = NewTheme.Main
            SetImageAsync(MainBgImage, "Image", NewTheme.Background or "")
            MainBgColor.BackgroundTransparency = NewTheme.Transparency or 0.25
            MainBgImage.ImageTransparency = NewTheme.ImageTransparency or 0
            OrbsTrans = NewTheme.OrbsTransparency or 0.5
            
            for _, child in pairs(OrbContainer:GetChildren()) do
                if child:IsA("Frame") then
                    child.BackgroundTransparency = OrbsTrans
                end
            end
            
            SelectedTheme = NewTheme
            Themes.Default.Main = NewTheme.Main
            Themes.Default.Second = NewTheme.Second
            Themes.Default.Accent = NewTheme.Accent
            Themes.Default.ElementAccent = NewTheme.ElementAccent
            Themes.Default.Text = NewTheme.Text
            
            if NewTheme.Font then
                UpdateFonts(NewTheme.Font)
            end
            
            UpdateThemeObjects()
            UpdateGradients(SelectedTheme.Gradient)
            Library:EmitThemeChanged(SelectedTheme, Library.MenuStyleActive == true)

            if Library.Items["Settings_MainColor"] then Library.Items["Settings_MainColor"].Set(NewTheme.Main) end
            if Library.Items["Settings_SecondColor"] then Library.Items["Settings_SecondColor"].Set(NewTheme.Second) end
            if Library.Items["Settings_ElementColor"] then Library.Items["Settings_ElementColor"].Set(NewTheme.ElementAccent) end
            if Library.Items["Settings_TextColor"] then Library.Items["Settings_TextColor"].Set(NewTheme.Text) end
            if Library.Items["Settings_GradStart"] then Library.Items["Settings_GradStart"].Set(NewTheme.GradientStart or NewTheme.Accent) end
            if Library.Items["Settings_GradEnd"] then Library.Items["Settings_GradEnd"].Set(NewTheme.GradientEnd or NewTheme.Accent) end
            if Library.Items["Settings_BgTrans"] then Library.Items["Settings_BgTrans"].Set(math.floor((NewTheme.Transparency or 0.25) * 100)) end
            if Library.Items["Settings_ImageTrans"] then Library.Items["Settings_ImageTrans"].Set(math.floor((NewTheme.ImageTransparency or 0) * 100)) end
            if Library.Items["Settings_OrbTrans"] then Library.Items["Settings_OrbTrans"].Set(math.floor((NewTheme.OrbsTransparency or 0.5) * 100)) end
            if Library.Items["Settings_BgImage"] then Library.Items["Settings_BgImage"].Set(NewTheme.Background or "") end
            if Library.Items["Settings_Font"] and NewTheme.Font then Library.Items["Settings_Font"].Set(NewTheme.Font) end
            if Library.Items["Settings_CornerRadius"] then Library.Items["Settings_CornerRadius"].Set(NewTheme.CornerRadius or 10) end

            Library:Notify({Title = "Theme Loaded", Content = "Loaded " .. val})
        end
    })

    ThemeBlock:CreateButton({
        Name = "Delete Selected Theme",
        Callback = function()
            local selected = LoadDrop:Get()
            if selected and isfile(Library.ThemeFolder .. "/" .. selected .. ".json") then
                delfile(Library.ThemeFolder .. "/" .. selected .. ".json")
                Library:Notify({Title = "Theme Deleted", Content = "Deleted " .. selected})
            else
                Library:Notify({Title = "Error", Content = "Select a valid theme first"})
            end
        end
    })

    return Funcs
end

			local desync = {
				On = false,
				Root = nil,
				Busy = false,
				Until = 0,
				NextCheck = 0,
				Token = 0,
				OrigRate = nil,
				Conn = nil
			}

			t66.Desync = desync
			desync.Supported = function()
				return type(sethiddenproperty) == "function" and type(setfflag) == "function" and type(getfflag) == "function"
			end
			desync.SetRate = function(p471)
				for _, v in ipairs({
					tostring(p471),
					p471
				}) do
					pcall(setfflag, "S2PhysicsSenderRate", v)

					local ok, result = pcall(getfflag, "S2PhysicsSenderRate")

					if ok and tonumber(result) == p471 then
						return true
					end
				end

				if spilled.n2 < n51 then
					return false
				end

				spilled.n2 = 730316657
				spilled.n1 = 542191273
				spilled.n4 = 659282760
				n50 += 1368
				n51 += 850
				n49 -= 311
			end
			desync.Reset = function()
				desync.Token += 1

				if desync.Root and desync.Root.Parent then
					pcall(sethiddenproperty, desync.Root, "PhysicsRepRootPart", nil)
				end

				desync.Root = nil
				desync.Busy = false
				desync.Until = 0

				if desync.Preview then
					desync.Preview.Clear()
				end

				return
			end
			desync.Fail = function()
				desync.Set(false)
				t66.SetToggle("ANONIM_DF_Desync", false)
			end
			desync.Update = function()
				if t66.UNL() or not desync.On then
					return
				end

				local now = os.clock()

				if desync.NextCheck <= now then
					desync.NextCheck = now + 1

					local ok, result = pcall(getfflag, "S2PhysicsSenderRate")

					if (not ok or tonumber(result) ~= 1000) and not desync.SetRate(1000) then
						return desync.Fail()
					end
				end

				local Character = LocalPlayer3.Character
				local HumanoidRootPart = Character and Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				local Humanoid = Character and Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

				if not Character or not Character.Parent or not HumanoidRootPart or not Humanoid or not (Humanoid.Health > 0) then
					if desync.Root then
						desync.Reset()
					end

					return
				end

				if HumanoidRootPart ~= desync.Root then
					desync.Reset()
					desync.Root = HumanoidRootPart

					if desync.Preview then
						desync.Preview.Capture(HumanoidRootPart, Character)
					end

					desync.Until = now + 0.14
				end

				if desync.Busy then
					return
				end

				if now < desync.Until then
					if pcall(sethiddenproperty, HumanoidRootPart, "PhysicsRepRootPart", HumanoidRootPart) then
						return
					end

					return desync.Fail()
				end

				desync.Busy = true

				local Root = desync.Root
				local Token = desync.Token

				if not pcall(sethiddenproperty, Root, "PhysicsRepRootPart", nil) then
					return desync.Fail()
				end

				task.wait(0.1)

				if Token ~= desync.Token or t66.UNL() or not desync.On or Root ~= desync.Root then
					return
				end

				if not Root.Parent or Character ~= LocalPlayer3.Character or Humanoid.Health <= 0 then
					return desync.Reset()
				end

				if not pcall(sethiddenproperty, Root, "PhysicsRepRootPart", Root) then
					return desync.Fail()
				end

				desync.Busy = false
				desync.Until = os.clock() + 0.14
			end
			desync.Set = function(p472)
				local on = p472 == true and not t66.UNL() and desync.Supported()

				if desync.On == on then
					return
				end

				if desync.Conn then
					pcall(function()
						desync.Conn:Disconnect()
					end)
					desync.Conn = nil
				end

				desync.On = on

				local os_

				if on then
					local ok, result = pcall(getfflag, "S2PhysicsSenderRate")

					if ok and tonumber(result) then
						desync.OrigRate = tonumber(result)
					end

					if desync.OrigRate == nil then
						return desync.Fail()
					end

					os_ = os
					desync.NextCheck = os_.clock() + 1

					if not desync.SetRate(1000) then
						return desync.Fail()
					end

					desync.Conn = t66.Track(RunService2.Heartbeat:Connect(desync.Update))

					if desync.Preview then
						desync.Preview.Start()
					end
				else
					local exitTo

					while true do
						break
					end

					if exitTo == 1 then
						desync.NextCheck = os_.clock() + 1

						if not desync.SetRate(1000) then
							return desync.Fail()
						end

						desync.Conn = t66.Track(RunService2.Heartbeat:Connect(desync.Update))

						if desync.Preview then
							desync.Preview.Start()
						end
					else
						desync.Reset()

						if desync.OrigRate ~= nil then
							desync.SetRate(desync.OrigRate)
						end

						if desync.Preview then
							desync.Preview.Stop()
						end
					end
				end
			end

			preview.IsLocator = function(p474)
				local isBasePart = p474 and p474.Parent and p474.Name == "PlayerCharacterLocationDetector" and p474:IsA("BasePart")

			preview.Foreign = function(p475)

			preview.Acceptable = function(p476, p477)

					return false

					if (p476.Position - p477.Position).Magnitude > 6 then

					preview.IgnoreDetector = nil
				end

			end
			preview.Peers = function()
				local t72 = {}

				for _, player in ipairs(Players3:GetPlayers()) do
					if player ~= LocalPlayer3 and player.Parent then
						local Character = player.Character
						local realHrp = Character and (Character:FindFirstChild("realHrp") or Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))

							t72[#t72 + 1] = realHrp.Position
						end
					end
				end

			end
			preview.NearPeer = function(p478, p479)
				for _, v in ipairs(p479) do

			end
			preview.Pause = function(p480, p481)
				preview.SafeAfter = p480 + 0.35
				preview.Candidate = nil

			end
			preview.Capture = function(p482, p483)
				preview.Clear()

				if not p482 or not p482.Parent or not preview.Finite(p482.Position) then
					return
				end

				preview.Root = p482
				preview.Character = p483

				local CFrame_ = p482.CFrame

				preview.AnchorCF = p482.CFrame
				preview.EstimateCF = CFrame_

				for _, child in ipairs(p483:GetChildren()) do
					if #preview.Shapes >= 18 then
						break
					end

					if child:IsA("BasePart") and child ~= p482 and child.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" and child.Name ~= "realHrp" and preview.Finite(child.Position) and preview.Finite(child.Size) then
						preview.Shapes[#preview.Shapes + 1] = {
							Name = child.Name,
							Size = child.Size,
							Offset = p482.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(child.CFrame)
						}
					end
				end

				if #preview.Shapes == 0 then
					preview.Shapes[1] = {
						Name = "Body",
						Size = Vector3.new(4, 6, 2),
						Offset = CFrame.new(0, 0.5, 0)
					}
				end
			end
			preview.LocalOverlap = function(p484, p485)
				local Magnitude = (p485 - p484.Position).Magnitude

				return preview.Separated and Magnitude <= 2 and Magnitude + 0.001 < (preview.EstimateCF.Position - p484.Position).Magnitude
			end
			preview.Discover = function(p486, p487, p488)
				if p487 < preview.NextProbe then
					return
				end

				preview.NextProbe = p487 + 0.1

				local Position = preview.EstimateCF.Position
				local huge = math.huge
				local huge2 = math.huge
				local v2102

				for _, child in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
					if preview.Acceptable(child, p486) and not (preview.NearPeer(child.Position, p488) or preview.LocalOverlap(p486, child.Position)) then
						local Magnitude = (child.Position - Position).Magnitude

						if Magnitude <= 6 then
							if Magnitude < huge then
								huge2 = huge
								huge = Magnitude
								v2102 = child
							elseif Magnitude < huge2 then
								huge2 = Magnitude
							end
						end
					end
				end

				if v2102 and huge2 - huge >= 0.75 then
					if preview.Candidate == v2102 then
						preview.Hits += 1
					else
						preview.Candidate = v2102
						preview.Hits = 1
					end

					if preview.Hits >= 5 then
						preview.Detector = v2102
						preview.Candidate = nil
						preview.Hits = 0
					end
				else
					preview.Candidate = nil
					preview.Hits = 0
				end
			end
			preview.ReadEstimate = function(p489, p490)
				local v2106 = preview.Peers()

				if (preview.EstimateCF.Position - p489.Position).Magnitude > 4 then
					preview.Separated = true
				end

				if preview.Detector and not preview.Acceptable(preview.Detector, p489) then
					preview.Detector = nil
					preview.Candidate = nil
					preview.Hits = 0
				end

				if preview.NearPeer(p489.Position, v2106) or preview.Detector and preview.NearPeer(preview.Detector.Position, v2106) then
					preview.Pause(p490, "AMBIGUOUS (NEAR PLAYER)")

					return preview.EstimateCF, preview.Source
				end

				if p490 < preview.SafeAfter then
					preview.Source = "RECHECKING (ESTIMATE)"

					return preview.EstimateCF, preview.Source
				end

				if not preview.Detector then
					preview.Discover(p489, p490, v2106)
				end

				if preview.Detector then
					local Position = preview.Detector.Position

					if (Position - preview.EstimateCF.Position).Magnitude > 6 then
						preview.Source = "UNCERTAIN SIGNAL (STALE)"

						return preview.EstimateCF, preview.Source
					end

					if preview.LocalOverlap(p489, Position) then
						preview.Source = "LOCAL OVERLAP (UNVERIFIED)"

						return preview.EstimateCF, preview.Source
					end

					preview.EstimateCF = CFrame.new(Position) * preview.AnchorCF.Rotation
					preview.HadLive = true
					preview.Source = "LIVE DETECTOR (ESTIMATE)"
				else
					preview.Source = preview.HadLive and "LAST KNOWN (STALE)" or "NO LIVE DATA"
				end

				return preview.EstimateCF, preview.Source
			end
			preview.Part = function(p491, p492, p493, p494)
				local Part = Instance.new("Part")

				Part.Name = p491
				Part.Size = p492

				Part.Massless = true

				Part.Color = Color
				Part.Transparency = p493
				Part.Parent = p494

				return Part
			end
			preview.BuildGhost = function()
				preview.DestroyGhost()

				local Model = Instance.new("Model")

			preview.Update = function(p495)
				if t66.UNL() or not desync.On then
					preview.DestroyGhost()

					return
				end

				local now = os.clock()

				if not p495 and now < preview.NextDraw then
					return
				end

				preview.NextDraw = now + 0.033333333333333333

				local Character = LocalPlayer3.Character
				local HumanoidRootPart = Character and Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				local Humanoid = Character and Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

				if not Character or not Character.Parent or HumanoidRootPart ~= desync.Root or HumanoidRootPart ~= preview.Root or not HumanoidRootPart or not HumanoidRootPart.Parent or not Humanoid or Humanoid.Health <= 0 or not preview.AnchorCF then
					preview.DestroyGhost()

					return
				end

				local v2127, v2128 = preview.ReadEstimate(HumanoidRootPart, now)

				if not v2127 or not preview.Finite(v2127.Position) or not preview.Finite(HumanoidRootPart.Position) then
					return
				end

				local Magnitude = (HumanoidRootPart.Position - v2127.Position).Magnitude

				if not preview.Model or not preview.Model.Parent or not preview.Marker or not preview.Marker.Parent then
					if now < preview.RetryAt then
						return
					end

					preview.BuildGhost()
				end

				local CurrentCamera = workspace.CurrentCamera or workspace

				if preview.Model.Parent ~= CurrentCamera then
					preview.Model.Parent = CurrentCamera
				end

				local Follower = preview.Follower
				local CFrame_ = HumanoidRootPart.CFrame

				preview.Marker.CFrame = v2127
				Follower.CFrame = CFrame_

				for _, piece in ipairs(preview.Pieces) do
					piece.Part.CFrame = v2127 * piece.Offset
				end

				preview.Beam.Enabled = Magnitude > 1
				preview.Caption.Text = string.format("DESYNC POSITION (%s)\n%.1f studs from local position", v2128 == "LIVE DETECTOR (ESTIMATE)" and "LIVE ESTIMATE" or v2128 == "AMBIGUOUS (NEAR PLAYER)" and "PAUSED: NEAR PLAYER" or v2128 == "RECHECKING (ESTIMATE)" and "RECHECKING ESTIMATE" or v2128 == "UNCERTAIN SIGNAL (STALE)" and "UNCERTAIN ESTIMATE" or v2128 == "LOCAL OVERLAP (UNVERIFIED)" and "LOCAL OVERLAP: UNVERIFIED" or v2128 == "LAST KNOWN (STALE)" and "STALE ESTIMATE" or "NO LIVE DATA", Magnitude)
			end
			preview.SafeUpdate = function(p496)
				if not pcall(preview.Update, p496) then
					preview.DestroyGhost()
					preview.RetryAt = os.clock() + 2

					if not (preview.Warned or t66.UNL()) then
						preview.Warned = true
						t66.Notify("The local desync marker could not be rendered. It will retry automatically.", "Position Desync")
					end
				end
			end
			preview.Stop = function()

				preview.Clear()
			end

			end

			t84.KickStep = function(...)
				local Kicking = t84.Kicking
				local InPlot = LocalPlayer3:FindFirstChild("InPlot")

				if not t84.LoopSel then
					for k in pairs(Kicking) do
						H.KickCleanup(k)
						Kicking[k] = nil
					end

					return
				end

				local v2771 = v2500()
				local Methods = t84.Methods
				local Selected = t84.Selected
				local Value = InPlot and InPlot.Value

				for k in pairs(Kicking) do
					if k and (not k.Parent or not Methods.Kick or Value or not Selected[k] or ANONIM_IsWL(k)) then
						H.KickCleanup(k)
						Kicking[k] = nil
					end
				end

				if not v2771 or not Methods.Kick or Value then
					return
				end

				local _, v2777, v2778 = H.Char()

				if not v2777 or not v2778 or not (v2778.Health > 0) then
					return
				end

				local t91 = {}

				for k in pairs(Selected) do
					if k and k.Parent and k:IsA("Player") and not ANONIM_IsWL(k) then
						t91[#t91 + 1] = k
						Kicking[k] = true
					end
				end

				if #t91 == 0 then
					return
				end

				for i, v in ipairs(t91) do
					if v2777 and v2778 and v2778.Health > 0 then
						if not InPlot or not InPlot.Value then
							local v2783, v2784, v2785 = H.Char(v)
							local Torso = v2783 and v2783:FindFirstChild("Torso")

							if v2784 and v2785 and Torso and v2785.Health > 0 then
								local v2787 = H.CirclePos(v2777, i, #t91)
								local KickAP = v2784:FindFirstChild("KickAP")
								local KickAO = v2784:FindFirstChild("KickAO")
								local WeldHRP = v2784:FindFirstChild("WeldHRP")

								if not KickAP or not KickAO then
									if KickAP then
										KickAP:Destroy()
									end

									if KickAO then
										KickAO:Destroy()
									end

									KickAP = Instance.new("BodyPosition")

									local BodyGyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro")

									KickAP.D = 200
									KickAP.MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
									KickAP.Position = v2787
									KickAP.Parent = v2784
									BodyGyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
									BodyGyro.D = 200
									BodyGyro.CFrame = CFrame.new()
									BodyGyro.Parent = v2784
									KickAP.Name = "KickAP"
									BodyGyro.Name = "KickAO"
								end

								if WeldHRP then
									WeldHRP.Enabled = false
								end

								KickAP.Position = v2787

								if H.Magnitude(v2777, v2784) > 33 then
									if H.SNO(v2784) then
										H.Teleport(v2784, v2787)
										v2771.Grab(v2784)
										H.AfterKickGrab(v, v2783, v2784)
									else
										H.EKISet(v2784, nil)
									end
								else
									v2771.Grab(v2784)
									H.AfterKickGrab(v, v2783, v2784)
								end
							else
								H.KickCleanup(v)
							end
						end
					end
				end

				if t84.NKDelayMode == "Normal" then
					task.wait()
				end
			end

				end

function ANONIM_DebugReport(name, stage, err, block)
    pcall(function()
        local text = "[ANONIM] " .. tostring(name) .. " | stage: " .. tostring(stage) .. " | error: " .. tostring(err or "none")
        warn(text)
        ANONIM_DebugLog = (ANONIM_DebugLog or "") .. text .. "\n"
        pcall(function() if writefile then writefile("ANONIM_HUB_debug.txt", ANONIM_DebugLog) end end)
        pcall(function()
            Library:Notify({Title = tostring(name) .. " debug", Content = string.sub(text, 1, 220), Duration = 30})
        end)
        if block then
            pcall(function()
                block:CreateDivider("Debug - stage: " .. tostring(stage))
                local e = tostring(err or "none")
                for i = 1, math.min(#e, 240), 60 do
                    block:CreateDivider(string.sub(e, i, i + 59))
                end
                block:CreateButton({Name = "Copy debug info", Callback = function()
                    pcall(function() setclipboard(text) end)
                end})
            end)
        end
    end)
end

            function G:AddSlider(flag, cfg)
                cfg = cfg or {}
                local s = {Type = "Slider", Value = cfg.Default or 0, Callback = cfg.Callback}
                function s:OnChanged(f) s.Changed = f end
                function s:SetValue(v)
                    local it = Library.Items[LibFlag(flag)]
                    if it and it.Set then it.Set(v) else s.Value = v; Fire(s, v) end
                end
                creating = creating + 1
                Track(function()
                    block:CreateSlider({
                        Name = Strip(cfg.Text or flag),
                        Flag = LibFlag(flag),
                        Min = cfg.Min or 0, Max = cfg.Max or 100,
                        Default = cfg.Default or 0,
                        Rounding = cfg.Rounding,
                        Callback = function(v)
                            if creating > 0 then return end
                            s.Value = v
                            Fire(s, v)
                        end,
                    })
                end)
                creating = creating - 1
                options[flag] = s
                return s
            end
            function G:AddDropdown(flag, cfg)
                cfg = cfg or {}
                local d = {Type = "Dropdown", Callback = cfg.Callback, Multi = cfg.Multi}
                function d:OnChanged(f) d.Changed = f end
                if cfg.SpecialType == "Player" then
                    d.Value = {}
                    local function FromLabels(sel)
                        local nv = {}
                        for label, on in pairs(sel or {}) do
                            local p = on and FromPLabel(label)
                            if p and p ~= LP_ and not IsWL(p) then nv[p] = true end
                        end
                        return nv
                    end
                    local dd
                    creating = creating + 1
                    Track(function()
                        dd = block:CreateDropdown({
                            Name = Strip(cfg.Text or "Players"),
                            Flag = LibFlag(flag),
                            Items = PLabels(),
                            Multi = true,
                            PlayerIcons = true,
                            UpdateList = PLabels,
                            Callback = function(sel)
                                if creating > 0 then return end
                                d.Value = FromLabels(sel)
                                Fire(d, d.Value)
                            end,
                        })
                    end)
                    creating = creating - 1
                    function d:SetValue(val)
                        local labels = {}
                        if type(val) == "table" then
                            for k, on in pairs(val) do
                                if on and typeof(k) == "Instance" and k:IsA("Player") and k ~= LP_ and not IsWL(k) then
                                    labels[PLabel(k)] = true
                                end
                            end
                        end
                        if dd and dd.Set then
                            dd.Set(labels)
                        else
                            d.Value = FromLabels(labels)
                            Fire(d, d.Value)
                        end
                    end
                    local function Refresh()
                        if dd and dd.Refresh then pcall(function() dd:Refresh(PLabels()) end) end
                    end
                    Players_.PlayerAdded:Connect(function() if not UNL() then Refresh() end end)
                    Players_.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function()
                        task.delay(0.3, function() if not UNL() then Refresh() end end)
                    end)
                    -- Whitelist'e eklenen oyuncu secimden cikar
                    task.spawn(function()
                        while not UNL() do
                            task.wait(1)
                            local bad = false
                            for p in pairs(d.Value) do
                                if IsWL(p) then bad = true break end
                            end
                            if bad then
                                local keep = {}
                                for p in pairs(d.Value) do
                                    if not IsWL(p) then keep[p] = true end
                                end
                                pcall(function() d:SetValue(keep) end)
                            end
                        end
                    end)
                else
                    local items = {}
                    for _, v in ipairs(cfg.Values or {}) do items[#items + 1] = tostring(v) end
                    d.Value = cfg.Default
                    creating = creating + 1
                    Track(function()
                        block:CreateDropdown({
                            Name = Strip(cfg.Text or flag),
                            Flag = LibFlag(flag),
                            Items = items,
                            Default = cfg.Default,
                            Callback = function(v)
                                if creating > 0 then return end
                                d.Value = v
                                Fire(d, v)
                            end,
                        })
                    end)
                    creating = creating - 1
                    function d:SetValue(v)
                        local it = Library.Items[LibFlag(flag)]
                        if it and it.Set then it.Set(v) else d.Value = v; Fire(d, v) end
                    end
                end
                options[flag] = d
                return d
            end
            function G:AddDependencyBox()
                local DB = setmetatable({}, {__index = G})
                local items = {}
                local function wrap(name)
                    return function(_, ...)
                        local prev = collect
                        collect = items
                        local r = G[name](G, ...)
                        collect = prev
                        return r
                    end
                end
                for _, n in ipairs({"AddDivider", "AddLabel", "AddButton", "AddCheckbox", "AddSlider", "AddDropdown"}) do
                    DB[n] = wrap(n)
                end
                function DB:SetupDependencies(deps)
                    local function Update()
                        local vis = true
                        for _, dep in ipairs(deps or {}) do
                            local obj, want = dep[1], dep[2]
                            if not obj or (obj.Value and true or false) ~= (want and true or false) then vis = false end
                        end
                        for _, f in ipairs(items) do
                            pcall(function() f.Visible = vis end)
                        end
                    end
                    for _, dep in ipairs(deps or {}) do
                        if dep[1] and dep[1]._deps then table.insert(dep[1]._deps, Update) end
                    end
                    Update()
                end
                return DB
            end
            function G:AddTabbox()
                local first = true
                return {
                    AddTab = function()
                        if first then first = false return G end
                        return Sink
                    end,
                }
            end
            return G
        end

    local T2NDBG = {stage = 0}

        T2NDBG.stage = 18233; local Tab = Tabs.Target2
        T2NDBG.stage = 18234; if not Tab then return end
        T2NDBG.stage = 18235; local RealLib = Library
        T2NDBG.stage = 18236; local Players_ = game:GetService("Players")
        T2NDBG.stage = 18237; local LP_ = Players_.LocalPlayer
        T2NDBG.stage = 18238; local function UNL() return _G.ANONIM_UNLOADED == true end
        T2NDBG.stage = 18239; local function IsWL(p)
            local ok, r = pcall(function() return ANONIM_IsWL and ANONIM_IsWL(p) end)
            return ok and r == true
        end
        T2NDBG.stage = 18243; local function NNotify(text, dur)
            pcall(function()
                RealLib:Notify({Title = "Target 2", Content = tostring(text or ""), Duration = dur or 3})
            end)
        end
        T2NDBG.stage = 18248; local NV = {Options = {}, Toggles = {}, Blocks = {}, Hidden = {}}
        T2NDBG.stage = 18249; ANONIM_T2N = NV
        T2NDBG.stage = 18250; local Options, Toggles = NV.Options, NV.Toggles
        T2NDBG.stage = 18251; local creating = 0
        T2NDBG.stage = 18252; local function LibFlag(flag) return "ANONIM_T2N_" .. tostring(flag) end
        T2NDBG.stage = 18253; local function Run(fn, ...)
            if type(fn) ~= "function" then return end
            local args = table.pack(...)
            task.spawn(function()
                local ok, e = pcall(fn, table.unpack(args, 1, args.n))
                if not ok and not tostring(e):find("__loopbreak") then warn("[ANONIM] Target 2: " .. tostring(e)) end
            end)
        end
        T2NDBG.stage = 18261; local function RunSync(fn, ...)
            if type(fn) ~= "function" then return end
            local ok, e = pcall(fn, ...)
            if not ok and not tostring(e):find("__loopbreak") then warn("[ANONIM] Target 2: " .. tostring(e)) end
        end
        -- Etiketler: ANONIM "Display (@name)"  <->  ANONIM "Display [name]"
        T2NDBG.stage = 18267; local function ALabel(p) return tostring(p.DisplayName) .. " (@" .. tostring(p.Name) .. ")" end
        T2NDBG.stage = 18268; local function NLabel(p) return tostring(p.DisplayName) .. " [" .. tostring(p.Name) .. "]" end
        T2NDBG.stage = 18269; local function FromALabel(l)
            if type(l) ~= "string" then return nil end
            local u = l:match("%(@([^%)]+)%)%s*$")
            return u and Players_:FindFirstChild(u) or nil
        end
        T2NDBG.stage = 18274; local function FromNLabel(l)
            if type(l) ~= "string" then return nil end
            local u = l:match("%[(.-)%]")
            return u and Players_:FindFirstChild(u) or nil
        end
        T2NDBG.stage = 18279; local function ALabels()
            local list = {}
            for _, p in ipairs(Players_:GetPlayers()) do

            end

            return list
        end

        -- ---------- ANONIM -> ANONIM library adaptoru ----------
        T2NDBG.stage = 18289; local function MakeGroup(blk, cont)
            local G = {Block = blk}
            local function Track(fn)
                local before = {}
                if cont then for _, ch in ipairs(cont:GetChildren()) do before[ch] = true end end
                local r = fn()
                local new = {}
                if cont then
                    for _, ch in ipairs(cont:GetChildren()) do
                        if not before[ch] and ch:IsA("GuiObject") then new[#new + 1] = ch end
                    end
                end
                return r, new
            end
            local function SetVis(frames, v)
                for _, f in ipairs(frames or {}) do
                    NV.Hidden[f] = (not v) or nil
                    pcall(function()
                        if not v then f.Visible = false end
                        if v and NV.Reshow then NV.Reshow(f) end
                    end)
                    if not v and not f:GetAttribute("ANONIM_T2N_Hook") then
                        pcall(function()
                            f:SetAttribute("ANONIM_T2N_Hook", true)
                            f:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
                                if NV.Hidden[f] and f.Visible then f.Visible = false end
                            end)
                        end)
                    end
                end
            end
            function G:AddDivider(text)
                Track(function() blk:CreateDivider(text) end)
            end
            function G:AddLabel(text)
                local L = {}
                function L:SetText() end
                function L:AddKeyPicker(kflag, kcfg)
                    kcfg = kcfg or {}
                    Track(function()
                        blk:CreateKeybind({
                            Name = tostring(text), Flag = LibFlag(kflag), Default = {Name = "None"},
                            Callback = function() if not UNL() then Run(kcfg.Callback) end end,
                        })
                    end)
                    return L
                end
                return L
            end
            function G:AddButton(cfg)
                cfg = cfg or {}
                local B = {}
                local function Press() if not UNL() then Run(cfg.Func) end end
                Track(function() blk:CreateButton({Name = tostring(cfg.Text or "Button"), Callback = Press}) end)
                function B:AddKeyPicker(kflag, kcfg)
                    kcfg = kcfg or {}
                    Track(function()
                        blk:CreateKeybind({
                            Name = tostring(cfg.Text or "Button") .. " Keybind", Flag = LibFlag(kflag), Default = {Name = "None"},
                            Callback = function()
                                if UNL() then return end
                                if kcfg.Callback then Run(kcfg.Callback) else Press() end
                            end,
                        })
                    end)
                    return B
                end
                return B
            end
            local function AddToggle(_, flag, cfg)
                cfg = cfg or {}
                local lf = LibFlag(flag)
                local t = {Type = "Toggle", Value = cfg.Default and true or false}
                function t:SetValue(v)
                    v = v and true or false
                    local it = RealLib.Items[lf]
                    if it and it.Set then
                        if t.Value ~= v then it.Set(v) end
                    elseif t.Value ~= v then
                        t.Value = v
                        Run(cfg.Callback, v)
                    end
                end
                function t:AddKeyPicker(kflag, kcfg)
                    kcfg = kcfg or {}
                    Track(function()
                        blk:CreateKeybind({
                            Name = tostring(cfg.Text or flag) .. " Keybind", Flag = LibFlag(kflag), Default = {Name = "None"},
                            Callback = function()
                                if UNL() then return end
                                if kcfg.Callback then Run(kcfg.Callback) else t:SetValue(not t.Value) end
                            end,
                        })
                    end)
                    return t
                end
                creating = creating + 1
                Track(function()
                    blk:CreateToggle({
                        Name = tostring(cfg.Text or flag), Flag = lf, Default = cfg.Default and true or false,
                        Callback = function(v)
                            if creating > 0 then return end
                            v = v and true or false
                            t.Value = v
                            if v and UNL() then return end
                            Run(cfg.Callback, v)
                        end,
                    })
                end)
                creating = creating - 1
                Toggles[flag] = t
                return t
            end
            G.AddToggle = AddToggle
            G.AddCheckbox = AddToggle
            function G:AddSlider(flag, cfg)
                cfg = cfg or {}
                local s = {Type = "Slider", Value = cfg.Default or 0}
                local frames
                creating = creating + 1
                local _, nf = Track(function()
                    blk:CreateSlider({
                        Name = tostring(cfg.Text or flag), Flag = LibFlag(flag),
                        Min = cfg.Min or 0, Max = cfg.Max or 100, Default = cfg.Default or 0, Rounding = cfg.Rounding or 0,
                        Callback = function(v)
                            if creating > 0 then return end
                            s.Value = v
                            RunSync(cfg.Callback, v)
                        end,
                    })
                end)
                creating = creating - 1
                frames = nf
                function s:SetValue(v)
                    local it = RealLib.Items[LibFlag(flag)]
                    if it and it.Set then it.Set(v) else s.Value = v; RunSync(cfg.Callback, v) end
                end
                function s:SetVisible(v) SetVis(frames, v) end
                if cfg.Visible == false then SetVis(frames, false) end
                Options[flag] = s
                return s
            end
            function G:AddDropdown(flag, cfg)
                cfg = cfg or {}
                local d = {Type = "Dropdown", Multi = cfg.Multi}
                if flag == "TargetsDropdown" then
                    -- Oyuncu listesi: whitelist'teki oyuncular hedef olamaz
                    local sel = {}
                    local dd
                    local function Push(aset)
                        local nset = {}
                        sel = {}
                        local wlHit = {}
                        for label, on in pairs(aset or {}) do
                            local p = on and FromALabel(label)
                            if p and p ~= LP_ then
                                if IsWL(p) then
                                    wlHit[#wlHit + 1] = p.Name
                                else
                                    sel[ALabel(p)] = true
                                    nset[NLabel(p)] = true
                                end
                            end
                        end
                        if #wlHit > 0 then NNotify(table.concat(wlHit, ", ") .. " is whitelisted and can't be targeted!", 3) end
                        RunSync(cfg.Callback, nset)
                        return #wlHit > 0
                    end
                    creating = creating + 1
                    Track(function()
                        dd = blk:CreateDropdown({
                            Name = tostring(cfg.Text or "Players"), Flag = LibFlag(flag), Items = ALabels(),
                            Multi = true, PlayerIcons = true, UpdateList = ALabels,
                            Callback = function(aset)
                                if creating > 0 then return end
                                if Push(aset) and dd and dd.Set then
                                    local copy = {}
                                    for k in pairs(sel) do copy[k] = true end
                                    task.defer(function() pcall(dd.Set, copy) end)
                                end
                            end,
                        })
                    end)
                    creating = creating - 1
                    function d:SetValues()
                        if dd and dd.Refresh then pcall(function() dd:Refresh(ALabels()) end) end
                    end
                    function d:SetValue(list)
                        local aset = {}
                        for k, v in pairs(list or {}) do
                            local label = (type(k) == "number") and v or (v and k)
                            local p = FromNLabel(label) or FromALabel(label)
                            if p then aset[ALabel(p)] = true end
                        end
                        if dd and dd.Set then dd.Set(aset) else Push(aset) end
                    end
                    function d:GetActiveValues()
                        local out = {}
                        for label in pairs(sel) do
                            local p = FromALabel(label)
                            if p then out[#out + 1] = NLabel(p) end
                        end
                        return out
                    end
                    d.Selected = function() return sel end
                else
                    local items = {}
                    for _, v in ipairs(cfg.Values or {}) do items[#items + 1] = tostring(v) end
                    d.Value = cfg.Default
                    creating = creating + 1
                    Track(function()
                        blk:CreateDropdown({
                            Name = tostring(cfg.Text or flag), Flag = LibFlag(flag), Items = items, Default = cfg.Default,
                            Callback = function(v)
                                if creating > 0 then return end
                                d.Value = v
                                RunSync(cfg.Callback, v)
                            end,
                        })
                    end)
                    creating = creating - 1
                    function d:SetValue(v)
                        local it = RealLib.Items[LibFlag(flag)]
                        if it and it.Set then it.Set(v) else d.Value = v; RunSync(cfg.Callback, v) end
                    end
                end
                Options[flag] = d
                return d
            end
            return G
        end
        T2NDBG.stage = 18520; local function ContOf(blk)
            local c = nil
            pcall(function()
                local probe = blk:CreateCustom({Height = 1, Transparent = true})
                c = probe.Parent
                probe:Destroy()
            end)
            return c
        end
        T2NDBG.stage = 18529; local function NewBlockGroup(name, side, icon)
            local blk = Tab:CreateBlock({Name = name, Side = side, Icon = icon})

            NV.Blocks[name] = G
            return G
        end
        T2NDBG.stage = 18535; local function NewTabbox(name, side, defs, iconSheet, iconOff)
            local TB = ANONIM_MakeTabbox(Tab:CreateBlock({Name = name, Side = side}), defs)
            if iconSheet then TB.SetBlockIcon(iconSheet, iconOff) end
            local box = {TB = TB}
            for _, d in ipairs(defs) do
                local G = MakeGroup(TB.Proxy(d.Key), TB.Cont)
                -- Proxy olusturulan elemanlari kendi sekmesine tasir; Track'in buldugu
                -- cerceveler ayni cercevelerdir.
                box[d.Key] = G
                NV.Blocks[name .. "/" .. d.Key] = G
            end
            NV.Blocks[name] = box
            return box
        end

        T2NDBG.stage = 18550; NV.Reshow = function(f)
            local active = true
            for _, box in pairs(NV.Blocks) do
                local TB = type(box) == "table" and box.TB
                if TB and TB.Pages then
                    for key, items in pairs(TB.Pages) do
                        for _, it in ipairs(items) do
                            if it == f then active = (TB.Active == key) end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            f.Visible = active
        end

        T2NDBG.stage = 18657; NewToy = function(arg, arg2)
        	if not arg or not arg2 then
        		return nil
        	end

        	repeat
        		task.wait()
        	until LocalPlayer.CanSpawnToy.Value

        	local now2 = tick()
        	local v26 = nil

        	task.spawn(function()
        		while true do
        			task.spawn(function()
        				ReplicatedStorage.MenuToys.SpawnToyRemoteFunction:InvokeServer(arg, arg2, Vector3.zero)
        			end)

        			task.wait(0.1)
        			if not (v26 or tick() - now2 > 1.5) then
        				continue
        			end
        			break
        		end
        	end)

        	local v27, v28 = GetPlot()
        	if v27 and v28 then
        		v26 = v28:WaitForChild(arg, 1.5)
        		return v26
        	end
        	v26 = toysFolder:WaitForChild(arg, 1.5)
        	return v26
        end

        								v28.RotVelocity = Vector3.zero

        									if v28.Name == "Head" then

        									elseif v28.Name == "Left Arm" then
        										v28.CFrame = v27.Character.Torso.CFrame * CFrame.new(-1.5, 0, 0)
        									elseif v28.Name == "Right Arm" then
        										v28.CFrame = v27.Character.Torso.CFrame * CFrame.new(1.5, 0, 0)
        									elseif v28.Name == "Left Leg" then
        										v28.CFrame = v27.Character.Torso.CFrame * CFrame.new(-0.5, -2, 0)
        									elseif v28.Name == "Right Leg" then
        										v28.CFrame = v27.Character.Torso.CFrame * CFrame.new(0.5, -2, 0)
        									end
        								end
        							end
        						end
        					end
        				end
        			end)
        		end

        		local v27, v28

        		while LoopTargetEnabled do
        			for k, v29 in pairs(AllTargets) do
        				if char then
        					local v30, v31, v32 = GetHRH(char)

        					if v30 and v31 and v32 and v32.Health > 0 and v29 and v29.Character and v29.InPlot and not v29.InPlot.Value then
        						local v33, v34, v35 = GetHRH(v29.Character)
