        							local cFrame = v31.CFrame
        							local v36 = nil

        							if AutoBreakGucci and not BreakingNow then
        								local v37 = workspace:FindFirstChild(v29.Name .. "SpawnedInToys")

        								if v37 then
        									task.spawn(function()
        										BreakingNow = true

        										while v37 and LoopTargetEnabled and AutoBreakGucci and not AutoGucciEnabled and not v36 and task.wait() do
        											for _, v38 in pairs(v37:GetChildren()) do
        												local vehicleSeat = v38:FindFirstChildOfClass("VehicleSeat")

        												if vehicleSeat then
        													for _, v39 in pairs(v38:GetChildren()) do
        														if v39:IsA("Part") or v39:IsA("MeshPart") then
        															v39.CanCollide = false
        															v39.CanTouch = false
        														end
        													end

        													Teleport(vehicleSeat, v31.CFrame, CFrame.new(0, -5, 0))
        													v31.Anchored = true
        													task.wait()
        													vehicleSeat:Sit(v32)

        													for i = 1, 10 do
        														if v32 and v32.Health > 0 and vehicleSeat and vehicleSeat.Parent and vehicleSeat.Occupant and vehicleSeat.Occupant == v32 then
        															for _, v39 in pairs(char:GetChildren()) do
        																if v39.Name == "LocalCreatureControl" then
        																	v39.Enabled = false
        																end
        															end

        															if workspace:FindFirstChild("GrabParts") then
        																workspace.GrabParts:Destroy()
        															end

        															if char:FindFirstChild("GrabbingScript") then
        																char.GrabbingScript.Enabled = false
        																task.wait()
        																char.GrabbingScript.Enabled = true
        															end

        															v32.Sit = true
        															task.wait()
        															v32.Sit = false
        														end
        													end

        													if v31 then
        														v31.Velocity = Vector3.zero
        														task.wait()
        														v31.Anchored = false
        													end
        												end
        											end
        										end

        										BreakingNow = false
        									end)
        								end
        							end

        							if (v31.Position - v34.Position).Magnitude > 20 and LoopTargetMethod ~= "Network" and LoopTargetMethod ~= "Kill" and LoopTargetMethod ~= "Void" and LoopTargetMethod ~= "Send To The Heaven" then
        								while true do
        									task.wait()
        									Teleport(v31, v34.CFrame, CFrame.new(0, -8, 0))
        									v36 = Ownerboat(v33)
        									if not (not LoopTargetEnabled or not v31 or not v34 or not v33 or not v35 or v35.Health <= 0 or v36) then
        										continue
        									end
        									break
        								end

        								if v31 then
        									Teleport(v31, cFrame, CFrame.new(0, 0, 0))
        								end

        								if v36 then
        									Teleport(v33, v31.CFrame, CFrame.new(0, TargetsHeightNum, 0))
        								end
        							end

        							if LoopTargetMethod ~= "Network" and LoopTargetMethod ~= "Kill" and LoopTargetMethod ~= "Void" and LoopTargetMethod ~= "Send To The Heaven" then
        								local n13 = k * 6.2831853071795862 / #AllTargets
        								local n14 = math.cos(n13) * 10
        								local n15 = math.sin(n13) * 10

        								if v31 and v34 and not v34:FindFirstChild("LoopBodyPos") then
        									local bodyPosition = Instance.new("BodyPosition", v34)
        									bodyPosition.Position = v31.Position + Vector3.new(n14, TargetsHeightNum, n15)
        									bodyPosition.MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
        									bodyPosition.D = 100
        									bodyPosition.Name = "LoopBodyPos"
        								end

        								v34.LoopBodyPos.Position = v31.Position + Vector3.new(n14, TargetsHeightNum, n15)

        								if v31 and v34 and not v34:FindFirstChild("LoopBodyGyro") then
        									local bodyGyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro", v34)

		ApplyExplosionColor = function()
			for _, v in ipairs(GetParticles()) do
				local colorSequence

				if not (spilled.n5 < spilled.n3) then
					spilled.n2 += 875
					spilled.n1 = 656451835
					spilled.n5 += 33
					spilled.n3 = 378320136
					spilled.n4 = 432432525
				elseif RainbowExplosionEnabled then
					colorSequence = ColorSequence.new({
						ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.new(1, 0, 0)),
						ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.25, Color3.new(0, 1, 0)),
						ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Color3.new(0, 0, 1)),
						ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.75, Color3.new(1, 1, 0)),
						ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.new(1, 0, 0))
					})
				elseif ExplosionColorEnabled then
					colorSequence = ColorSequence.new(InvertColorEnabled and InvertColor(ExplosionColor) or ExplosionColor)
				else
					colorSequence = origexplosionpresets[v]
				end

				v.Color = colorSequence
			end
		end
		ApplyExplosionBrightness = function()
			for _, v in ipairs(GetParticles()) do
				if ExplosionBrightness == 10 then
					v.Brightness = origbrightnessvals[v]
				else
					v.Brightness = origbrightnessvals[v] * 2 * (ExplosionBrightness - 9)
				end
			end
		end
		ApplyParticleSize = function()
			for _, v in ipairs(GetParticles()) do
				orig = origsizevals[v]

				if orig then
					kps = orig.Keypoints
					newkps = {}

					for _, v2 in ipairs(kps) do
						table.insert(newkps, NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(v2.Time, v2.Value * ParticleSize, v2.Envelope))
					end

					v.Size = NumberSequence.new(newkps)
				end
			end
		end
		ApplyParticleSpeed = function()
			for _, v in ipairs(GetParticles()) do
				orig = origspeedvals[v]

				if orig then
					v.Speed = NumberRange.new(orig.Min * ParticleSpeed, orig.Max * ParticleSpeed)
				end
			end
		end
		ApplyParticleLifetime = function()
			for _, v in ipairs(GetParticles()) do
				orig = origlifetimevals[v]

				if orig then
					v.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(orig.Min * ParticleLifetime, orig.Max * ParticleLifetime)
				end
			end
		end
		ApplyParticleDensity = function()
			for _, v in ipairs(GetParticles()) do
				orig = origdensityvals[v]

				if orig then
					v.Rate = orig * ParticleDensity
				end
			end
		end
		ApplyParticleTransparency = function()
			for _, v in ipairs(GetParticles()) do
				if TransparentExplosionEnabled then
					v.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
						NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, ParticleTransparency),
						NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1)
					})
				else
					v.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
						NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0),
						NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1)
					})
				end
			end

			return
		end

		SetupBomb = function(p1941)
			if not p1941 or not p1941.PrimaryPart then
				return
			end

			hitPart = p1941:FindFirstChild(SetupParts[p1941.Name])

			if not hitPart then
				return
			end

			SetNetworkOwnership(hitPart)
			task.wait(0.05)
			pcall(function()
				for _, child in pairs(p1941.PrimaryPart:GetChildren()) do
					if child:IsA("BodyVelocity") or child.Name == "Stable" then
						child:Destroy()
					end
				end

				bodyVel = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
				bodyVel.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
				bodyVel.MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
				bodyVel.Name = "Stable"
				bodyVel.Parent = p1941.PrimaryPart
				p1941:PivotTo(CFrame.new(math.random(-500, 500), 10000, math.random(-500, 500)))
			end)
		end

		AutoExplosionLoop = function()
			if AutoExplosionRunning then
				return
			end

			AutoExplosionRunning = true

			local n191 = 0

			pcall(function()
				while AutoExplosionEnabled do
					if tick() - n191 < 0.05 then
						task.wait(0.05)
					else
						n191 = tick()

						local v6731, v6732 = ExpGetTargetHRP()

						if v6732 and v6731 then
							if v6732.Character then
								local Humanoid = v6732.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")

								if Humanoid and not (Humanoid.Health <= 0) then
									DeleteAllBombs()
									task.wait(0.1)

									local n192 = 0
									local n193 = 20

									while ExplosionAmount > #GetAllBombs() and AutoExplosionEnabled and n192 < n193 do
										SpawNoneBomb()
										n192 += 1
										task.wait(SpawnSpeed + 0.05)
									end

									task.wait(0.15)

									local v6733 = GetAllBombs()
									local v6734, v6735, v6736 = pairs(v6733)
									local v6737 = geniter(v6734, v6735, v6736)

									while true do
										local v6738 = table.pack(v6737())

										if v6738[1] then
											local v6739 = v6738[3]

											if not AutoExplosionEnabled then
												break
											end

											SetupBomb(v6739)
											task.wait(SetupSpeed or 0.05)

											continue
										end

										break
									end

									task.wait(0.2)

									local v6740, v6741 = ExpGetTargetHRP()

									if v6740 and v6741 then
										local v6742 = GetAllBombs()
										local v6743, v6744, v6745 = pairs(v6742)
										local v6746 = geniter(v6743, v6744, v6745)

										while true do
											local v6747 = table.pack(v6746())

											if v6747[1] then
												local v6748 = v6747[3]

												if not AutoExplosionEnabled then
													break
												end

												ExplodeBomb(v6748, v6740)
												task.wait(0.01)

												continue
											end

											break
										end
									end

									task.wait(0.15)
									DeleteAllBombs()
									task.wait(ExplosionInterval or 0.5)

									continue
								end
							end

							task.wait(0.5)
						else
							task.wait(0.5)
						end
					end
				end
			end)
			AutoExplosionRunning = false

			return
		end

		t264.removeHat = function(p2156)
			local v7475 = t264.HatParts[p2156]

			if v7475 then
				v7475:Destroy()
				t264.HatParts[p2156] = nil
			end
		end
		t264.addHat = function(p2157)
			task.wait(0.1)

			local Head = p2157 and p2157:FindFirstChild("Head")

			if not Head then
				return
			end

			t264.removeHat(p2157)

			local Part = Instance.new("Part")

			Part.Name = "Hat"
			Part.Transparency = t264.HatTransparency
			Part.Color = t264.HatColor
			Part.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
			Part.CanCollide = false
			Part.CanTouch = false

			local n222 = 272308928

			Part.CanQuery = false
			Part.Massless = true

			local SpecialMesh = Instance.new("SpecialMesh")

			SpecialMesh.MeshId = "rbxassetid://1033714"
			SpecialMesh.Scale = Vector3.new(2.4, 1.6, 2.4)
			SpecialMesh.Parent = Part

			local WeldConstraint = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")

			WeldConstraint.Part0 = Head
			WeldConstraint.Part1 = Part
			WeldConstraint.Parent = Part
			Part.CFrame = Head.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 1.1, 0)
			Part.Parent = p2157

			if spilled.n2 ~= n222 then
				t264.HatParts[p2157] = Part

				return
			end

			spilled.n5 = 510313959
			spilled.n4 -= 1792
			spilled.n1 = 429791751
			spilled.n2 -= 490
			spilled.n3 = 214049046
		end
		t264.updateHats = function()
			for k, hatPart in pairs(t264.HatParts) do
				if hatPart and hatPart.Parent and k == LocalPlayer2.Character then
					hatPart.Transparency = t264.HatTransparency
					hatPart.Color = t264.HatRainbow and Color3.fromHSV(tick() % 5 / 5, 1, 1) or t264.HatColor
				end
			end
		end

		local function removeTrail(p2158)
			if t264.TrailParts[p2158] then
				t264.TrailParts[p2158]:Destroy()
				t264.TrailParts[p2158] = nil
			end

			local HumanoidRootPart = p2158 and p2158:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

			if HumanoidRootPart then
				local TrailAttach0 = HumanoidRootPart:FindFirstChild("TrailAttach0")
				local TrailAttach1 = HumanoidRootPart:FindFirstChild("TrailAttach1")

				if TrailAttach0 then
					TrailAttach0:Destroy()
				end

				if TrailAttach1 then
					TrailAttach1:Destroy()
				end
			end
		end

		do
			t264.removeTrail = removeTrail
		end

		t264.addTrail = function(p2159)
			local HumanoidRootPart = p2159 and p2159:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

			if not HumanoidRootPart then
				return
			end

			t264.removeTrail(p2159)

			local Attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")

			Attachment.Name = "TrailAttach0"
			Attachment.Position = Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)
			Attachment.Parent = HumanoidRootPart

			local Attachment2 = Instance.new("Attachment")

			Attachment2.Name = "TrailAttach1"
			Attachment2.Position = Vector3.new(0, -2, 0)
			Attachment2.Parent = HumanoidRootPart

			local Trail = Instance.new("Trail")

			Trail.Attachment0 = Attachment
			Trail.Attachment1 = Attachment2
			Trail.Lifetime = t264.TrailLifetime
			Trail.LightEmission = 0.2
			Trail.Enabled = true
			Trail.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
				NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, t264.TrailTransparencyStart),
				NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1)
			})
			Trail.Color = t264.TrailGradient and ColorSequence.new(t264.TrailGradient1, t264.TrailGradient2) or ColorSequence.new(t264.TrailColorStatic)
			Trail.Parent = p2159
			t264.TrailParts[p2159] = Trail
		end
		t264.updateTrails = function()
			for k, trailPart in pairs(t264.TrailParts) do
				if trailPart and trailPart.Parent and k == LocalPlayer2.Character then
					trailPart.Lifetime = t264.TrailLifetime
					trailPart.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
						NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, t264.TrailTransparencyStart),
						NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1)
					})

					local color3 = t264.TrailRainbow and Color3.fromHSV(tick() % 5 / 5, 1, 1) or t264.TrailColorStatic

					trailPart.Color = t264.TrailGradient and ColorSequence.new(t264.TrailGradient1, t264.TrailGradient2) or ColorSequence.new(color3)
				end
			end
		end
		t264.toggleSkinTrail = function(p2160)
			local Character = LocalPlayer2.Character

			if not Character then
				return
			end

			local HumanoidRootPart = Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

			if not HumanoidRootPart then
				return
			end

			local v7496, v7497, v7498 = ipairs(Character:GetChildren())
			local v7499 = geniter(v7496, v7497, v7498)
			local exitTo2
			local exitTo

			while true do
				local v7502 = table.pack(v7499())

				if not v7502[1] then
					break
				end

				local v7503 = v7502[3]

				exitTo = nil

				while true do
					if not v7503:IsA("BasePart") or v7503 == HumanoidRootPart then
						exitTo = 1

						break
					end

					if p2160 then
						if v7503:FindFirstChild("SkinTrail") then
							exitTo = 1

							break
						end

						local Trail = Instance.new("Trail")

						Trail.Name = "SkinTrail"
						Trail.Texture = "rbxassetid://1390780157"
						Trail.Color = ColorSequence.new(t264.SkinTrailColor)
						Trail.Lifetime = t264.SkinTrailLife
						Trail.Parent = v7503

						local Attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")

						Attachment.Name = "SkinPointer1"
						Attachment.Parent = v7503

						local Attachment2 = Instance.new("Attachment")

						Attachment2.Name = "SkinPointer2"
						Attachment2.Parent = HumanoidRootPart
						Trail.Attachment0 = Attachment
						Trail.Attachment1 = Attachment2

						local v7507 = table.pack(v7499())

						if v7507[1] then
							v7503 = v7507[3]

							continue
						end
					else
						local SkinTrail = v7503:FindFirstChild("SkinTrail")
						local SkinPointer1 = v7503:FindFirstChild("SkinPointer1")

						if SkinTrail then
							SkinTrail:Destroy()
						end

						if SkinPointer1 then
							SkinPointer1:Destroy()
						end

						local v7510 = table.pack(v7499())

						if v7510[1] then
							v7503 = v7510[3]

							continue
						end

						exitTo = 2

						break
					end

					break
				end

				if exitTo ~= 1 then
					exitTo2 = 1

					break
				end
			end

			local SkinPointer2

			if exitTo2 == 1 then
				if exitTo == 2 then
					SkinPointer2 = HumanoidRootPart:FindFirstChild("SkinPointer2")

					if SkinPointer2 then
						SkinPointer2:Destroy()
					end
				end
			elseif not p2160 then
				SkinPointer2 = HumanoidRootPart:FindFirstChild("SkinPointer2")

				if SkinPointer2 then
					SkinPointer2:Destroy()
				end
			end

			return
		end
		t264.updateSkinTrail = function()
			local Character = LocalPlayer2.Character

			if not Character then
				return
			end

			for _, descendant in ipairs(Character:GetDescendants()) do
				if descendant:IsA("Trail") and descendant.Name == "SkinTrail" then
					descendant.Color = ColorSequence.new(t264.SkinTrailColor)
					descendant.Lifetime = t264.SkinTrailLife
				end
			end
		end
		t264.saveOriginalColors = function(p2161)
			t264.OriginalColors[p2161] = {}

			for _, descendant in ipairs(p2161:GetDescendants()) do
				if descendant:IsA("BasePart") and descendant.Name ~= "Hat" then
					t264.OriginalColors[p2161][descendant] = {
						Color = descendant.Color,
						Material = descendant.Material
					}
				end
			end

			if spilled.n4 == 381339008 then
				spilled.n2 = 1058846640
				spilled.n1 = 633802274
				spilled.n4 -= 1062
				spilled.n5 = 73097075
				spilled.n3 -= 792
			end
		end
		t264.applyForceField = function(p2162)
			t264.saveOriginalColors(p2162)

			local v7517, s34, Name

			for _, descendant in ipairs(p2162:GetDescendants()) do
				v7517 = descendant
				s34 = "BasePart"
				Name = descendant.IsA(v7517, s34)

				if Name then
					Name = descendant.Name

					if Name ~= "Hat" then
						descendant.Color = t264.ForceFieldColor
						Name = Enum.Material.ForceField
						descendant.Material = Name
					end
				end
			end
		end
		t264.removeForceField = function(p2163)
			local v7522 = t264.OriginalColors[p2163]

			if not v7522 then
				return
			end

			for k, v in pairs(v7522) do
				if k and k.Parent and k:IsA("BasePart") then
					k.Color = v.Color
					k.Material = v.Material
				end
			end

			t264.OriginalColors[p2163] = nil
		end
		t264.updateForceField = function()
			local n223 = 1026465529

			if not LocalPlayer2.Character or not t264.ForceFieldEnabled then
				return
			end

			for _, descendant in ipairs(LocalPlayer2.Character:GetDescendants()) do
				if descendant:IsA("BasePart") and descendant.Name ~= "Hat" and descendant.Material == Enum.Material.ForceField then
					descendant.Color = t264.ForceFieldRainbow and Color3.fromHSV(tick() % 5 / 5, 1, 1) or t264.ForceFieldColor
				end
			end

			if not (spilled.n1 < n223) then
				spilled.n4 -= 1198
				spilled.n2 = 313077632
				spilled.n1 -= 2
				spilled.n5 += 186
				spilled.n3 = 351412289
			end
		end

		local function disableAura()
			for _, auraEffect in ipairs(t264.AuraEffects) do
				if auraEffect and auraEffect.Parent then
					auraEffect:Destroy()
				end
			end

			table.clear(t264.AuraEffects)
		end

		do
			t264.disableAura = disableAura
		end

		t264.enableAura = function(p2164)
			t264.disableAura()

			if not t264.CurrentAuraModel then
				return
			end

			local clone = t264.CurrentAuraModel:Clone()

			for _, descendant in ipairs(clone:GetDescendants()) do
				if descendant:IsA("BasePart") then
					continue
				end

				local clone2 = descendant:Clone()
				local Name = descendant.Parent and descendant.Parent.Name
				local BasePart = Name and p2164:FindFirstChild(Name) or p2164:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")

				if BasePart and not BasePart:FindFirstChild(clone2.Name) then
					clone2.Parent = BasePart
					table.insert(t264.AuraEffects, clone2)

					continue
				end
			end

			clone:Destroy()
		end
		t264.updateAuraLogic = function()
			local v7537 = t264.CustomAuraID ~= "" and "rbxassetid://" .. t264.CustomAuraID:gsub("%D", "") or t264.AuraModels[t264.AuraType]

			if not v7537 then
				return
			end

			local ok, currentAuraModel = pcall(function()
				return game:GetObjects(v7537)[1]
			end)

			if ok and currentAuraModel then
				t264.CurrentAuraModel = currentAuraModel

				if t264.AuraEnabled and LocalPlayer2.Character then
					t264.enableAura(LocalPlayer2.Character)
				end
			end
		end
		t264.applySkybox = function(p2165)
			local v7540 = t264.SkyboxAssets[p2165]

			if not v7540 then
				return
			end

			local Sky2 = Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("Sky") or Instance.new("Sky", Lighting)

			Sky2.Name = "Sky"
			Sky2.SkyboxBk = v7540.Bk

		t301.ResolveImage = function(p2594, p2595)

			if match == "" then

			end

			local v8598 = match:lower()
			local match2 = match:match("^%d+$") or v8598:match("^rbxassetid://(%d+)$")

			end

			end

			if not v8598:match("^https?://") then
				return v8517("Enter a Roblox image ID or a direct image link.")
			end

			local request_ = request or http_request or syn and syn.request
			local getcustomasset_ = getcustomasset or getsynasset

			if not request_ or not writefile or not getcustomasset_ then
				return v8517("Your executor can't load image links. Use a Roblox image ID.")
			end

			local match3 = (v8598:match("^[^?#]+") or v8598):match("%.([%w]+)$")

			if match3 ~= "png" and match3 ~= "jpg" and match3 ~= "jpeg" and match3 ~= "webp" then
				match3 = "png"
			end

			task.spawn(function()
				local ok, result = pcall(request_, {
					Url = match,
					Method = "GET"
				})

				if not ok or type(result) ~= "table" or result.StatusCode and result.StatusCode >= 400 or not result.Body then
					return v8517("Couldn't load the particle texture.")
				end

				local v8605 = "ANONIM_ParticleTexture." .. match3
				local ok2, result2 = pcall(function()
					writefile(v8605, result.Body)

					return getcustomasset_(v8605)
				end)

				if ok2 and result2 then
					p2595(result2)

					return
				end

				return v8517("Couldn't load the particle texture.")
			end)

			return
		end
